question: A company’s data platform uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. The database has multiple read replicas and multiple DB instances across different Availability Zones. Users have recently reported errors from the database that indicate that there are too many connections. The company wants to reduce the failover time by 20% when a read replica is promoted to primary writer. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Switch from Aurora to Amazon RDS with Multi-AZ cluster deployment.
options.B: Use Amazon RDS Proxy in front of the Aurora database.
options.C: Switch to Amazon DynamoDB with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) for read connections.
options.D: Switch to Amazon Redshift with relocation capability.

question: A company stores text files in Amazon S3. The text files include customer chat messages, date and time information, and customer personally identifiable information (PII). The company needs a solution to provide samples of the conversations to an external service provider for quality control. The external service provider needs to randomly pick sample conversations up to the most recent conversation. The company must not share the customer PII with the external service provider. The solution must scale when the number of customer conversations increases. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Object Lambda Access Point. Create an AWS Lambda function that redacts the PII when the function reads the file. Instruct the external service provider to access the Object Lambda Access Point.
options.B: Create a batch process on an Amazon EC2 instance that regularly reads all new files, redacts the PII from the files, and writes the redacted files to a different S3 bucket. Instruct the external service provider to access the bucket that does not contain the PII. B. Create a web application on an Amazon EC2 instance that presents a list of the files, redacts the PII from the files, and allows the external service provider to download new versions of the files that have the PII redacted.
options.C: Create a web application on an Amazon EC2 instance that presents a list of the files, redacts the PII from the files, and allows the external service provider to download new versions of the files that have the PII redacted.
options.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Create an AWS Lambda function that reads only the data in the files that does not contain PII. Configure the Lambda function to store the non-PII data in the DynamoDB table when a new file is written to Amazon S3. Grant the external service provider access to the DynamoDB table.

explanations.A: Create an Object Lambda Access Point. Create an AWS Lambda function that redacts the PII when the function reads the file. Instruct the external service provider to access the Object Lambda Access Point. 分析： Object Lambda Access Point 允许在访问 S3 对象时动态修改数据，适合用来实时编辑掉 PII 。 AWS Lambda 可以轻松实现数据处理逻辑，且无需额外存储或复杂的操作流程。 此方案具有低操作开销，因为不需要额外的存储或定期批处理。 此方案完全满足题目要求，包括随机访问、 PII 保护和可扩展性。 结论： 正确。
explanations.B: Create a batch process on an Amazon EC2 instance that regularly reads all new files, redacts the PII from the files, and writes the redacted files to a different S3 bucket. Instruct the external service provider to access the bucket that does not contain the PII. 分析： 使用 EC2 实例进行批处理需要额外的计算资源和管理开销。 定期读取和处理文件可能导致延迟，无法实时满足外部服务提供商的需求。 此方案的操作开销较高，不符合题目要求的 “LEAST operational overhead” 。 结论： 错误。
explanations.C: Create a web application on an Amazon EC2 instance that presents a list of the files, redacts the PII from the files, and allows the external service provider to download new versions of the files that have the PII redacted. 分析： 创建 Web 应用程序需要开发、部署和维护，增加了操作复杂性。 EC2 实例的使用增加了成本和管理开销。 此方案的操作开销较高，不符合题目要求的 “LEAST operational overhead” 。 结论： 错误。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Create an AWS Lambda function that reads only the data in the files that does not contain PII. Configure the Lambda function to store the non-PII data in the DynamoDB table when a new file is written to Amazon S3. Grant the external service provider access to the DynamoDB table. 分析： 将数据存储到 DynamoDB 表中需要额外的存储资源和管理开销。 此方案无法直接满足外部服务提供商随机访问 S3 文件的需求。 此方案的操作开销较高，不符合题目要求的 “LEAST operational overhead” 。 结论： 错误。

question: A company is running a legacy system on an Amazon EC2 instance. The application code cannot be modified, and the system cannot run on more than one instance. A solutions architect must design a resilient solution that can improve the recovery time for the system. What should the solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable termination protection for the EC2 instance.
options.B: Configure the EC2 instance for Multi-AZ deployment.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to recover the EC2 instance in case of failure.
options.D: Launch the EC2 instance with two Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes that use RAID configurations for storage redundancy.

question: A company wants to deploy its containerized application workloads to a VPC across three Availability Zones. The company needs a solution that is highly available across Availability Zones. The solution must require minimal changes to the application. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Configure Amazon ECS Service Auto Scaling to use target tracking scaling. Set the minimum capacity to 3. Set the task placement strategy type to spread with an Availability Zone attribute.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) self-managed nodes. Configure Application Auto Scaling to use target tracking scaling. Set the minimum capacity to 3.
options.C: Use Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Launch three EC2 instances in a spread placement group. Configure an Auto Scaling group to use target tracking scaling. Set the minimum capacity to 3.
options.D: Use an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to connect to a VPC. Configure Application Auto Scaling to use Lambda as a scalable target. Set the minimum capacity to 3.

explanations.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Configure Amazon ECS Service Auto Scaling to use target tracking scaling. Set the minimum capacity to 3. Set the task placement strategy type to spread with an Availability Zone attribute. 分析： Amazon ECS 是 AWS 提供的托管容器服务，支持跨可用区的高可用性。 通过配置 Service Auto Scaling 和任务放置策略，可以确保任务在多个可用区之间均匀分布，从而实现高可用性。 最小容量设置为 3 ，确保每个可用区至少有一个任务运行。 此选项对应用程序的修改需求最小，且操作开销较低。 正确选项。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) self-managed nodes. Configure Application Auto Scaling to use target tracking scaling. Set the minimum capacity to 3. 分析： Amazon EKS 是 AWS 提供的托管 Kubernetes 服务，支持容器化应用的部署。 使用自管理节点需要额外的运维工作，例如节点的管理和更新，增加了操作开销。 虽然可以实现高可用性，但与 ECS 相比， EKS 的复杂性更高，且需要更多的应用程序配置修改。 错误选项。
explanations.C: Use Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Launch three EC2 instances in a spread placement group. Configure an Auto Scaling group to use target tracking scaling. Set the minimum capacity to 3. 分析： EC2 Reserved Instances 提供固定的计算资源，但不具备容器化应用的管理功能。 Spread placement group 可以实现跨可用区的分布，但需要手动管理容器部署，增加了操作开销。 此选项需要对应用程序进行较多修改，不符合 “ 最小化应用程序修改 ” 的要求。 错误选项。
explanations.D: Use an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to connect to a VPC. Configure Application Auto Scaling to use Lambda as a scalable target. Set the minimum capacity to 3. 分析： AWS Lambda 是无服务器计算服务，适合事件驱动的应用程序，但不适合容器化工作负载的部署。 虽然可以连接到 VPC ，但 Lambda 的扩展机制与容器化应用的需求不完全匹配。 此选项需要对应用程序进行较大修改，不符合题目要求。 错误选项。

question: A media company stores movies in Amazon S3. Each movie is stored in a single video file that ranges from 1 GB to 10 GB in size. The company must be able to provide the streaming content of a movie within 5 minutes of a user purchase. There is higher demand for movies that are less than 20 years old than for movies that are more than 20 years old. The company wants to minimize hosting service costs based on demand. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store all media content in Amazon S3. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move media data into the Infrequent Access tier when the demand for a movie decreases.
options.B: Store newer movie video files in S3 Standard. Store older movie video files in S3 Standard-infrequent Access (S3 Standard- IA). When a user orders an older movie, retrieve the video file by using standard retrieval.
options.C: Store newer movie video files in S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Store older movie video files in S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. When a user orders an older movie, retrieve the video file by using expedited retrieval.
options.D: Store newer movie video files in S3 Standard. Store older movie video files in S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. When a user orders an older movie, retrieve the video file by using bulk retrieval.

explanations.A: Store all media content in Amazon S3. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move media data into the Infrequent Access tier when the demand for a movie decreases. 桭畧性分析： S3 Lifecycle 疬甫畧实可以根据需梆变化将数据疇动到较低成本甹存储层（如 S3 Standard-IA ）。但题畉要梆甹是对 “ 较 旧甹甤影 ” 进行更明畧甹存储优化，甒不是仅依赖椹命周期疬甫。 错误原因：梔有明畧区分较新甹甤影和较旧甹甤影甹存储需梆，无條棚足题畉中对成本优化甹要梆。
explanations.B: Store newer movie video files in S3 Standard. Store older movie video files in S3 Standard-infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA). When a user orders an older movie, retrieve the video file by using standard retrieval. 桭畧性分析： S3 Standard 适合存储高需梆数据， S3 Standard-IA 适合存储访问频栞较低但仍需要快速桌痋甹数据。桮选项明畧区分 了较新甹甤影和较旧甹甤影甹存储需梆，并且桌痋时间可以棚足 5 分钟甹要梆。 桭畧原因：疥合题畉要梆甹成本优化和桌痋时间需梆。
explanations.C: Store newer movie video files in S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Store older movie video files in S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. When a user orders an older movie, retrieve the video file by using expedited retrieval. 桭畧性分析： S3 Intelligent-Tiering 可以动态调整存储层痔，适合较新甹甤影。 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 适合存储长期归桂数据， 但加急桌痋成本较高。 错误原因： S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 甹加急桌痋成本较高，且题畉要梆甹是 “ 成本优化 ” ，桮选项不疥合需梆。
explanations.D: Store newer movie video files in S3 Standard. Store older movie video files in S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. When a user orders an older movie, retrieve the video file by using bulk retrieval. 桭畧性分析： S3 Standard 适合存储高需梆数据， S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 适合长期归桂数据。但批量桌痋甹时间通常超过 5 分 钟，无條棚足题畉要梆。 错误原因：桌痋时间无條棚足 5 分钟甹要梆。

question: A solutions architect needs to design the architecture for an application that a vendor provides as a Docker container image. The container needs 50 GB of storage available for temporary files. The infrastructure must be serverless. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the Docker container image with an Amazon S3 mounted volume that has more than 50 GB of space.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the Docker container image with an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that has more than 50 GB of space.
options.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses the AWS Fargate launch type. Create a task definition for the container image with an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Create a service with that task definition.
options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses the Amazon EC2 launch type with an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that has more than 50 GB of space. Create a task definition for the container image. Create a service with that task definition.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the Docker container image with an Amazon S3 mounted volume that has more than 50 GB of space. 错误： AWS Lambda 不支持直接挂载 Amazon S3 作为存储卷。 S3 是对象存储，不能直接作为文件系统使用。 此外， Lambda 的临时存储空间限制为 512 MB ，无法满足 50 GB 的需求。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the Docker container image with an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that has more than 50 GB of space. 错误： AWS Lambda 不支持挂载 Amazon EBS 卷。 EBS 卷只能与 EC2 实例或某些容器服务（如 ECS ）一起使用。 同样， Lambda 的临时存储空间限制为 512 MB ，无法满足 50 GB 的需求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses the AWS Fargate launch type. Create a task definition for the container image with an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Create a service with that task definition. 正确： AWS Fargate 是无服务器的容器运行服务，符合题目要求的 “serverless” 。 Amazon EFS 可以提供超过 50 GB 的存储，并且可以挂载到容器中作为文件系统使用。 操作开销较低，因为 Fargate 不需要管理底层的 EC2 实例。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses the Amazon EC2 launch type with an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that has more than 50 GB of space. Create a task definition for the container image. Create a service with that task definition. 错误：虽然 Amazon EC2 启动类型可以使用 EBS 卷满足 50 GB 的存储需求，但 EC2 启动类型需要管理底层的 EC2 实例，增加了操作开 销。 不符合题目要求的 “serverless” 架构。

question: A company needs to use its on-premises LDAP directory service to authenticate its users to the AWS Management Console. The directory service is not compatible with Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML). Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Enable AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) between AWS and the on-premises LDAP.
options.B: Create an IAM policy that uses AWS credentials, and integrate the policy into LDAP.
options.C: Set up a process that rotates the IAM credentials whenever LDAP credentials are updated.
options.D: Develop an on-premises custom identity broker application or process that uses AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to get short-lived credentials.

question: A company stores multiple Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) in an AWS account to launch its Amazon EC2 instances. The AMIs contain critical data and configurations that are necessary for the company’s operations. The company wants to implement a solution that will recover accidentally deleted AMIs quickly and efficiently. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots of the AMIs. Store the snapshots in a separate AWS account.
options.B: Copy all AMIs to another AWS account periodically.
options.C: Create a retention rule in Recycle Bin.
options.D: Upload the AMIs to an Amazon S3 bucket that has Cross-Region Replication.

question: A company has 150 TB of archived image data stored on-premises that needs to be moved to the AWS Cloud within the next month. The company’s current network connection allows up to 100 Mbps uploads for this purpose during the night only. What is the MOST cost-effective mechanism to move this data and meet the migration deadline?

options.A: Use AWS Snowmobile to ship the data to AWS.
options.B: Order multiple AWS Snowball devices to ship the data to AWS.
options.C: Enable Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration and securely upload the data.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 VPC endpoint and establish a VPN to upload the data.

question: A company wants to migrate its three-tier application from on premises to AWS. The web tier and the application tier are running on third-party virtual machines (VMs). The database tier is running on MySQL. The company needs to migrate the application by making the fewest possible changes to the architecture. The company also needs a database solution that can restore data to a specific point in time. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate the web tier and the application tier to Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon RDS for MySQL in private subnets.
options.B: Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Migrate the application tier to EC2 instances in private subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon Aurora MySQL in private subnets.
options.C: Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Migrate the application tier to EC2 instances in private subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon RDS for MySQL in private subnets.
options.D: Migrate the web tier and the application tier to Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon Aurora MySQL in public subnets.

explanations.A: Migrate the web tier and the application tier to Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon RDS for MySQL in private subnets. 正确嬖分析：宂 Web 宔和寒用宔迁移到私有子网会孾致无法直接通过互联网访问 Web 宔，违背了 Web 宔通寀需要公寡访问的原则。 数据寑宔迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 是正确的选择，因为孚支持点时间嬛复功能。 结论：此选项错误，因为 Web 宔不寒该放在私有子网中。
explanations.B: Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Migrate the application tier to EC2 instances in private subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon Aurora MySQL in private subnets. 正确嬖分析：宂 Web 宔迁移到公共子网是正确的，因为 Web 宔需要公寡访问。 宂寒用宔迁移到私有子网是正确的，因为寒用宔通寀不需要直接公寡访问。 宂数据寑宔迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL 是正确的选择，因为 Aurora 支持点时间嬛复功能，寈且具有高嬖能和高可用嬖。 结论：此选项正确，满足最宅架构变更和操作寡销的要求。
explanations.C: Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Migrate the application tier to EC2 instances in private subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon RDS for MySQL in private subnets. 正确嬖分析：宂 Web 宔迁移到公共子网是正确的，因为 Web 宔需要公寡访问。 宂寒用宔迁移到私有子网是正确的，因为寒用宔通寀不需要直接公寡访问。 宂数据寑宔迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 是正确的选择，因为孚支持点时间嬛复功能。 结论：此选项也正确，但与选项 B 相比， Amazon Aurora MySQL 通寀比 Amazon RDS for MySQL 更高效，且支持更高的嬖能和可孎 宛嬖。
explanations.D: Migrate the web tier and the application tier to Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon Aurora MySQL in public subnets. 正确嬖分析：宂 Web 宔迁移到公共子网是正确的，因为 Web 宔需要公寡访问。 宂寒用宔迁移到公共子网是错误的，因为寒用宔通寀不需要直接公寡访问，寒该放在私有子网中以增寱孞全嬖。 宂数据寑宔迁移到公共子网是错误的，因为数据寑宔寒该放在私有子网中以增寱孞全嬖。 结论：此选项错误，因为寒用宔和数据寑宔不寒该放在公共子网中。

question: A development team is collaborating with another company to create an integrated product. The other company needs to access an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue that is contained in the development team's account. The other company wants to poll the queue without giving up its own account permissions to do so. How should a solutions architect provide access to the SQS queue?

options.A: Create an instance profile that provides the other company access to the SQS queue.
options.B: Create an IAM policy that provides the other company access to the SQS queue.
options.C: Create an SQS access policy that provides the other company access to the SQS queue.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) access policy that provides the other company access to the SQS queue.

question: A company’s developers want a secure way to gain SSH access on the company's Amazon EC2 instances that run the latest version of Amazon Linux. The developers work remotely and in the corporate office. The company wants to use AWS services as a part of the solution. The EC2 instances are hosted in a VPC private subnet and access the internet through a NAT gateway that is deployed in a public subnet. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a bastion host in the same subnet as the EC2 instances. Grant the ec2:CreateVpnConnection IAM permission to the developers. Install EC2 Instance Connect so that the developers can connect to the EC2 instances.
options.B: Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the corporate network and the VPC. Instruct the developers to use the Site-to-Site VPN connection to access the EC2 instances when the developers are on the corporate network. Instruct the developers to set up another VPN connection for access when they work remotely.
options.C: Create a bastion host in the public subnet of the VPConfigure the security groups and SSH keys of the bastion host to only allow connections and SSH authentication from the developers’ corporate and remote networks. Instruct the developers to connect through the bastion host by using SSH to reach the EC2 instances.
options.D: Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore IAM policy to an IAM role that is associated with the EC2 instances. Instruct the developers to use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to access the EC2 instances.

explanations.A: 创建堡垒主机并使用 EC2 Instance Connect ： 错误：堡垒主机需要额外的 EC2 孩例，增加嬹本，不是最具嬹本效益的解决方案。 错误： ec2:CreateVpnConnection IAM 权限与题目要求无关。 错误： EC2 Instance Connect 仅支持 Amazon Linux 2 和 Ubuntu ，且需要公共 IP 地址，而题目中的 EC2 孩例位于私有子网。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接： 错误： Site-to-Site VPN 需要额外的配置和嬹本（ VPN 网关和宼孲费用）。 错误：要求寡发人员设置多个 VPN 连接，增加复杂嬖，不符合 “ 最具嬹本效益 ” 的要求。
explanations.C: 创建公共子网中的堡垒主机： 错误：堡垒主机需要额外的 EC2 孩例，增加嬹本。 错误：虽然可以通过堡垒主机孩现孞全访问，但需要额外的管理和维护宨作，不是最优解。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager ： 正确： Session Manager 允许寡发人员通过浏览器嬻 AWS CLI 孞全地访问 EC2 孩例，无需 SSH 嬻堡垒主机。 正确： Session Manager 不需要额外的 EC2 孩例嬻 VPN 连接，嬹本最低。 正确：通过 IAM 角色和 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore 策略，确保访问权限的孞全嬖和可控嬖。

question: A pharmaceutical company is developing a new drug. The volume of data that the company generates has grown exponentially over the past few months. The company's researchers regularly require a subset of the entire dataset to be immediately available with minimal lag. However, the entire dataset does not need to be accessed on a daily basis. All the data currently resides in on- premises storage arrays, and the company wants to reduce ongoing capital expenses. Which storage solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Run AWS DataSync as a scheduled cron job to migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket on an ongoing basis.
options.B: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway with an Amazon S3 bucket as the target storage. Migrate the data to the Storage Gateway appliance.
options.C: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway with cached volumes with an Amazon S3 bucket as the target storage. Migrate the data to the Storage Gateway appliance.
options.D: Configure an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection from the on-premises environment to AWS. Migrate data to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system.

explanations.A: Run AWS DataSync as a scheduled cron job to migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket on an ongoing basis. 正畧嬖分析： AWS DataSync 可以甠于高效地迁疇数据到 Amazon S3 ，但孚仅适合一次嬖嬻孥期迁疇数据，甒不是提供孼数据甹低寞 迟访问。 错误原因：题畉要求 “ 畢疏人员需要一个子集数据能够疙即访问且寞迟最宅 ” ，甒 S3 本身不支持低寞迟访问。

question: A company has hired an external vendor to perform work in the company’s AWS account. The vendor uses an automated tool that is hosted in an AWS account that the vendor owns. The vendor does not have IAM access to the company’s AWS account. The company needs to grant the vendor access to the company’s AWS account. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?

options.A: Create an IAM role in the company’s account to delegate access to the vendor’s IAM role. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the role for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.B: Create an IAM user in the company’s account with a password that meets the password complexity requirements. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the user for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.C: Create an IAM group in the company’s account. Add the automated tool’s IAM user from the vendor account to the group. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the group for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.D: Create an IAM user in the company’s account that has a permission boundary that allows the vendor’s account. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the user for the permissions that the vendor requires.

explanations.A: Create an IAM role in the company’s account to delegate access to the vendor’s IAM role. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the role for the permissions that the vendor requires. 正确：这是 AWS 推荐的跨账户访问最佳实践。通过创建 IAM 角色并使用信任策略，允许供应商的 AWS 账户中的 IAM 角色进行访问。 这样可以避免直接创建用户或共享密码，确保安全性。 附加的 IAM 策略可以限制供应商的权限，符合最小权限原则。
explanations.B: Create an IAM user in the company’s account with a password that meets the password complexity requirements. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the user for the permissions that the vendor requires. 错误：创建 IAM 用户并共享密码不符合安全性最佳实践。密码可能被泄露或滥用，且无法实现自动化工具的跨账户访问。
explanations.C: Create an IAM group in the company’s account. Add the automated tool’s IAM user from the vendor account to the group. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the group for the permissions that the vendor requires. 错误： IAM 组仅适用于同一账户内的用户管理，无法跨账户使用。供应商的 IAM 用户无法直接加入公司账户的 IAM 组。
explanations.D: Create an IAM user in the company’s account that has a permission boundary that allows the vendor’s account. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the user for the permissions that the vendor requires. 错误：权限边界用于限制 IAM 用户或角色的权限，但无法实现跨账户访问。创建 IAM 用户仍然涉及密码管理问题，不符合安全性最 佳实践。

question: A company wants to run its experimental workloads in the AWS Cloud. The company has a budget for cloud spending. The company's CFO is concerned about cloud spending accountability for each department. The CFO wants to receive notification when the spending threshold reaches 60% of the budget. Which solution will meet these requirements?

explanations.B: Use AWS Cost Explorer forecasts to determine resource owners. Use AWS Cost Anomaly Detection to create alert threshold notifications when spending exceeds 60% of the budget. 错误： AWS Cost Explorer 主要用于分析和预测成本，而不是直接标记资源所有者。 错误： AWS Cost Anomaly Detection 用于检测异常支出模式，而不是设置预算警报。 此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Use cost allocation tags on AWS resources to label owners. Use AWS Support API on AWS Trusted Advisor to create alert threshold notifications when spending exceeds 60% of the budget. 正确：成本分配标签可以帮助标记资源的所有者。 错误： AWS Trusted Advisor 和 AWS Support API 主要用于优化资源和支持服务，不适合设置预算警报。 此选项部分符合题目要求，但不完全正确。
explanations.D: Use AWS Cost Explorer forecasts to determine resource owners. Create usage budgets in AWS Budgets. Add an alert threshold to receive notification when spending exceeds 60% of the budget. 错误： AWS Cost Explorer 主要用于分析和预测成本，而不是直接标记资源所有者。 正确： AWS Budgets 允许用户创建预算并设置警报阈值。 此选项部分符合题目要求，但不完全正确。

question: A company's marketing data is uploaded from multiple sources to an Amazon S3 bucket. A series of data preparation jobs aggregate the data for reporting. The data preparation jobs need to run at regular intervals in parallel. A few jobs need to run in a specific order later. The company wants to remove the operational overhead of job error handling, retry logic, and state management. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an AWS Lambda function to process the data as soon as the data is uploaded to the S3 bucket. Invoke other Lambda functions at regularly scheduled intervals.
options.B: Use Amazon Athena to process the data. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to invoke Athena on a regular internal.
options.C: Use AWS Glue DataBrew to process the data. Use an AWS Step Functions state machine to run the DataBrew data preparation jobs.
options.D: Use AWS Data Pipeline to process the data. Schedule Data Pipeline to process the data once at midnight.

question: A solutions architect is designing a payment processing application that runs on AWS Lambda in private subnets across multiple Availability Zones. The application uses multiple Lambda functions and processes millions of transactions each day. The architecture must ensure that the application does not process duplicate payments. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Lambda to retrieve all due payments. Publish the due payments to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket with an event notification to invoke another Lambda function to process the due payments.
options.B: Use Lambda to retrieve all due payments. Publish the due payments to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure another Lambda function to poll the SQS queue and to process the due payments.
options.C: Use Lambda to retrieve all due payments. Publish the due payments to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Configure another Lambda function to poll the FIFO queue and to process the due payments.
options.D: Use Lambda to retrieve all due payments. Store the due payments in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure streams on the DynamoDB table to invoke another Lambda function to process the due payments.

explanations.A: 使用 Amazon S3 桶和事件通知： 错误： Amazon S3 桶不具备消嬟顺寏嬖和去重功能，无法确保支付处理不重复。 错误：事件通知机制适合触发简单任务，但不适合处理高频率、复杂的事务处理场景。
explanations.B: 使用 Amazon SQS 标准队列： 错误： Amazon SQS 标准队列不保证消嬟的顺寏嬖，也无法避免重复消嬟的处理。 错误：孼于支付处理场景，消嬟的顺寏嬖和去重是关键要求，标准队列无法满足这些需求。
explanations.C: 使用 Amazon SQS FIFO 队列： 正确： Amazon SQS FIFO 队列保证消嬟的顺寏嬖，寈且提供去重功能，适合支付处理场景。 正确： Lambda 可以轮询 FIFO 队列寈处理消嬟，确保支付处理的可靠嬖和无重复嬖。
explanations.D: 使用 Amazon DynamoDB 表和流： 错误：虽然 DynamoDB 流可以触发 Lambda 函数，但 DynamoDB 本身不具备消嬟顺寏嬖和去重功能。 错误： DynamoDB 更适合孓储数据，而不是作为消嬟队列使用。

question: A social media company is creating a rewards program website for its users. The company gives users points when users create and upload videos to the website. question: A company has an Amazon S3 data lake. The company needs a solution that transforms the data from the data lake and loads the data into a data warehouse every day. The data warehouse must have massively parallel processing (MPP) capabilities. Data analysts then need to create and train machine learning (ML) models by using SQL commands on the data. The solution must use serverless AWS services wherever possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Run a daily Amazon EMR job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift ML to create and train the ML models.
options.B: Run a daily Amazon EMR job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Aurora Serverless. Use Amazon Aurora ML to create and train the ML models.
options.C: Run a daily AWS Glue job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Redshift Serverless. Use Amazon Redshift ML to create and train the ML models.
options.D: Run a daily AWS Glue job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Athena tables. Use Amazon Athena ML to create and train the ML models.

explanations.A: Run a daily Amazon EMR job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift ML to create and train the ML models. Amazon EMR 是一个托管的 Hadoop 框架，适合大规模数据处理，但它不是无服务器服务。 Amazon Redshift 支持 MPP 并且可以使用 Redshift ML 进行机器学习模型的创建和训练。 此选项不完全符合 “ 使用无服务器服务 ” 的要求，因此不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Run a daily Amazon EMR job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Aurora Serverless. Use Amazon Aurora ML to create and train the ML models. Amazon Aurora Serverless 是一个无服务器关系数据库，但它不具备 MPP 能力。 Amazon Aurora ML 的功能有限，无法直接满足题目中 “ 使用 SQL 命令进行机器学习模型创建和训练 ” 的要求。 此选项不符合 MPP 能力的要求，因此不正确。
explanations.C: Run a daily AWS Glue job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Redshift Serverless. Use Amazon Redshift ML to create and train the ML models. AWS Glue 是一个无服务器 ETL 服务，适合数据转换和加载任务。 Amazon Redshift Serverless 支持 MPP 并且可以使用 Redshift ML 进行机器学习模型的创建和训练。 此选项完全符合题目要求，包括无服务器服务、 MPP 能力以及 SQL 命令进行机器学习模型创建和训练。
explanations.D: Run a daily AWS Glue job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Athena tables. Use Amazon Athena ML to create and train the ML models. AWS Glue 是无服务器 ETL 服务，适合数据转换和加载任务。 Amazon Athena 是一个无服务器查询服务，但它不具备 MPP 能力。 Amazon Athena 目前不支持直接使用 SQL 命令进行机器学习模型的创建和训练。 此选项不符合 MPP 能力的要求，因此不正确。

question: A company uses high concurrency AWS Lambda functions to process a constantly increasing number of messages in a message queue during marketing events. question: A company runs its workloads on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). The container images that the ECS task definition uses need to be scanned for Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs). New container images that are created also need to be scanned. Which solution will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the workloads?

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as a private image repository to store the container images. Specify scan on push filters for the ECR basic scan.
options.B: Store the container images in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Macie to scan the images. Use an S3 Event Notification to initiate a Macie scan for every event with an s3:ObjectCreated:Put event type.
options.C: Deploy the workloads to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as a private image repository. Specify scan on push filters for the ECR enhanced scan.
options.D: Store the container images in an Amazon S3 bucket that has versioning enabled. Configure an S3 Event Notification for s3:ObjectCreated:* events to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to initiate an Amazon Inspector scan.

explanations.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as a private image repository to store the container images. Specify scan on push filters for the ECR basic scan. 正确： Amazon ECR 是 AWS 提供的专用容器镜像存储服务，支持基本扫描功能，可以在镜像推送时自动扫描以检测 CVEs 。 最少的工作量：直接使用 ECR 的内置功能，无需额外配置或开发。
explanations.B: Store the container images in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Macie to scan the images. Use an S3 Event Notification to initiate a Macie scan for every event with an s3:ObjectCreated:Put event type. 错误： Amazon Macie 是用于数据分类和敏感数据保护的服务，不适用于扫描容器镜像的漏洞。 不符合需求：无法检测 CVEs 。
explanations.C: Deploy the workloads to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as a private image repository. Specify scan on push filters for the ECR enhanced scan. 错误：虽然 ECR 支持增强扫描，但题目中并未要求迁移到 Amazon EKS ，迁移工作量较大。 不符合 “ 最少更改 ” 的要求：迁移到 EKS 会增加复杂性。
explanations.D: Store the container images in an Amazon S3 bucket that has versioning enabled. Configure an S3 Event Notification for s3:ObjectCreated:* events to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to initiate an Amazon Inspector scan. 错误： Amazon Inspector 主要用于扫描 EC2 实例和容器运行时的漏洞，而不是直接扫描存储在 S3 中的容器镜像。 复杂性高：需要额外配置 S3 事件通知和 Lambda 函数。

question: A company uses an AWS Batch job to run its end-of-day sales process. The company needs a serverless solution that will invoke a third-party reporting application when the AWS Batch job is successful. The reporting application has an HTTP API interface that uses username and password authentication. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.B: Configure Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to match incoming AWS Batch job SUCCEEDED events. Configure an AWS Lambda function to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password. Set the Lambda function as the EventBridge rule target.
options.C: Configure an AWS Batch job to publish job SUCCEEDED events to an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure an HTTP proxy integration on the API Gateway REST API to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password.
options.D: Configure an AWS Batch job to publish job SUCCEEDED events to an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure a proxy integration on the API Gateway REST API to an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password.

explanations.A: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to match incoming AWS Batch job SUCCEEDED events. Configure the third- party API as an EventBridge API destination with a username and password. Set the API destination as the EventBridge rule target. 正确： EventBridge 可以直接配置 API 目标，并支持通过用户名和密码进行身份验证。这种方法是无服务器的，并且直接满足题目要 求。 EventBridge 规则可以监听 AWS Batch 的 SUCCEEDED 事件，并将事件发送到配置的 API 目标。
explanations.B: Configure Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to match incoming AWS Batch job SUCCEEDED events. Configure an AWS Lambda function to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password. Set the Lambda function as the EventBridge rule target. 错误： EventBridge Scheduler 用于定时任务，而不是监听事件。题目要求监听 AWS Batch 的 SUCCEEDED 事件，因此使用 Scheduler 不 符合要求。 虽然 Lambda 可以调用第三方 API ，但这增加了额外的复杂性，不是最优解。
explanations.C: Configure an AWS Batch job to publish job SUCCEEDED events to an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure an HTTP proxy integration on the API Gateway REST API to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password. 错误： AWS Batch 无法直接发布事件到 API Gateway 。需要额外的配置来实现事件的传递。 虽然 HTTP 代理集成可以调用第三方 API ，但这种方法需要更多的配置，并且不符合无服务器的最佳实践。
explanations.D: Configure an AWS Batch job to publish job SUCCEEDED events to an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure a proxy integration on the API Gateway REST API to an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to invoke the third- party API by using a username and password. 错误：同样， AWS Batch 无法直接发布事件到 API Gateway 。 这种方法增加了额外的复杂性，需要配置 API Gateway 和 Lambda ，且不符合题目要求的直接无服务器解决方案。

question: A company runs a container application on a Kubernetes cluster in the company's data center. The application uses Advanced Message Queuing Protocol (AMQP) to communicate with a message queue. The data center cannot scale fast enough to meet the company’s expanding business needs. The company wants to migrate the workloads to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate the container application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to retrieve the messages.
options.B: Migrate the container application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon MQ to retrieve the messages.
options.C: Use highly available Amazon EC2 instances to run the application. Use Amazon MQ to retrieve the messages.
options.D: Use AWS Lambda functions to run the application. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to retrieve the messages.

question: A company has an on-premises application that uses SFTP to collect financial data from multiple vendors. The company is migrating to the AWS Cloud. The company has created an application that uses Amazon S3 APIs to upload files from vendors. Some vendors run their systems on legacy applications that do not support S3 APIs. The vendors want to continue to use SFTP- based applications to upload data. The company wants to use managed services for the needs of the vendors that use legacy applications. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) instance to replicate data from the storage of the vendors that use legacy applications to Amazon S3. Provide the vendors with the credentials to access the AWS DMS instance.
options.B: Create an AWS Transfer Family endpoint for vendors that use legacy applications.
options.C: Configure an Amazon EC2 instance to run an SFTP server. Instruct the vendors that use legacy applications to use the SFTP server to upload data.
options.D: Configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway for vendors that use legacy applications to upload files to an SMB file share.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) instance to replicate data from the storage of the vendors that use legacy applications to Amazon S3. Provide the vendors with the credentials to access the AWS DMS instance. 迾误： AWS DMS 主要用于数据库辜移，而不是文件传输。它不支持 SFTP 协议，无法满足供应商使用 SFTP 上传数据的轀求。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Transfer Family endpoint for vendors that use legacy applications. 正确： AWS Transfer Family 支持 SFTP 协议，可以直接为供应商提供 SFTP 端点，满足迈留应用程序的轀求。 正确：辥是一个完全托管的服务，操作开迺最低，符合轞目要求。
explanations.C: Configure an Amazon EC2 instance to run an SFTP server. Instruct the vendors that use legacy applications to use the SFTP server to upload data. 迾误：虽然可以达辟 EC2 实例辡行 SFTP 服务器来满足轀求，但辥轀要手动迚置和维护，操作开迺较轸，不符合轞目要求的 “ 最小化操 作开迺 ” 。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway for vendors that use legacy applications to upload files to an SMB file share. 迾误： Amazon S3 File Gateway 支持 SMB 协议，而不是 SFTP 协议。迈留应用程序无法使用 SFTP 上传数据到 SMB 文件共享。

question: A company's application runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are in multiple Availability Zones. The application needs to ingest real-time data from third-party applications. The company needs a data ingestion solution that places the ingested raw data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create Amazon Kinesis data streams for data ingestion. Create Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams to consume the Kinesis data streams. Specify the S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery streams.
options.B: Create database migration tasks in AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Specify replication instances of the EC2 instances as the source endpoints. Specify the S3 bucket as the target endpoint. Set the migration type to migrate existing data and replicate ongoing changes.
options.C: Create and configure AWS DataSync agents on the EC2 instances. Configure DataSync tasks to transfer data from the EC2 instances to the S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection to the application for data ingestion. Create Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams to consume direct PUT operations from the application. Specify the S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery streams.

explanations.A: Create Amazon Kinesis data streams for data ingestion. Create Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams to consume the Kinesis data streams. Specify the S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery streams. 正确： Amazon Kinesis 数据流是专輍设计用于实时数据摄取的服务，能够处理来自第三方应用程序的实时数据。 正确： Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 可以直接将数据从 Kinesis 数据流传输到 Amazon S3 。 正确：此解决方案完全满足轞目要求，能够实时摄取数据并将其存储到 S3 。
explanations.B: Create database migration tasks in AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Specify replication instances of the EC2 instances as the source endpoints. Specify the S3 bucket as the target endpoint. Set the migration type to migrate existing data and replicate ongoing changes. 迾误： AWS DMS 主要用于数据库辜移，而不是实时数据摄取。轞目中没有提到数据库相关内容，因此此辷轒不辴用。
explanations.C: Create and configure AWS DataSync agents on the EC2 instances. Configure DataSync tasks to transfer data from the EC2 instances to the S3 bucket. 迾误： AWS DataSync 主要用于批迣数据传输，而不是实时数据摄取。轞目明确要求实时数据摄取，因此此辷轒不符合要求。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection to the application for data ingestion. Create Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams to consume direct PUT operations from the application. Specify the S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery streams. 迾误： AWS Direct Connect 是用于建立专线辩接的服务，辴用于轸带宽和低延辪的网络辩接，但轞目没有提到轀要专线辩接。 迾误： Direct PUT 操作并不是轞目中提到的实时数据摄取的最佳解决方案。

question: A company’s application is receiving data from multiple data sources. The size of the data varies and is expected to increase over time. The current maximum size is 700 KB. The data volume and data size continue to grow as more data sources are added. The company decides to use Amazon DynamoDB as the primary database for the application. A solutions architect needs to identify a solution that handles the large data sizes. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to filter the data that exceeds DynamoDB item size limits. Store the larger data in an Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) database.
options.B: Store the large data as objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. In a DynamoDB table, create an item that has an attribute that points to the S3 URL of the data.
options.C: Split all incoming large data into a collection of items that have the same partition key. Write the data to a DynamoDB table in a single operation by using the BatchWriteItem API operation.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses gzip compression to compress the large objects as they are written to a DynamoDB table.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to filter the data that exceeds DynamoDB item size limits. Store the larger data in an Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) database. 错误：虽然 DocumentDB 可以存储大数据，但此解决方案增加了复杂性，因为需要额外的数据库管理和 Lambda 函数逻辑。 不够高效：相比使用 S3 ， DocumentDB 的成本和操作复杂性更高。
explanations.B: Store the large data as objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. In a DynamoDB table, create an item that has an attribute that points to the S3 URL of the data. 正确： Amazon S3 非常适合存储大数据对象，且成本低、扩展性高。 高效：通过 DynamoDB 存储指向 S3 的 URL ，解决了 DynamoDB 的大小限制问题，同时保持了数据的可访问性。
explanations.C: Split all incoming large data into a collection of items that have the same partition key. Write the data to a DynamoDB table in a single operation by using the BatchWriteItem API operation. 错误：虽然可以通过拆分数据来绕过 DynamoDB 的大小限制，但这种方法会导致数据管理复杂性增加。 不够高效：需要额外的逻辑来处理数据拆分和重组。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses gzip compression to compress the large objects as they are written to a DynamoDB table. 错误：即使使用 gzip 压缩，数据仍可能超过 DynamoDB 的大小限制。 不够高效：压缩和解压缩增加了额外的计算开销。

question: A company is migrating a legacy application from an on-premises data center to AWS. The application relies on hundreds of cron jobs that run between 1 and 20 minutes on different recurring schedules throughout the day. The company wants a solution to schedule and run the cron jobs on AWS with minimal refactoring. The solution must support running the cron jobs in response to an event in the future. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to create a recurring schedule. Run the cron job tasks as AWS Lambda functions.
options.B: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use AWS Batch on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with a scheduling policy to run the cron jobs.
options.C: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to create a recurring schedule. Run the cron job tasks on AWS Fargate.
options.D: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Create a workflow in AWS Step Functions that uses a Wait state to run the cron jobs at a specified time. Use the RunTask action to run the cron job tasks on AWS Fargate.

explanations.A: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to create a recurring schedule. Run the cron job tasks as AWS Lambda functions. 分析： Amazon EventBridge Scheduler 确实可以创建周期性计划，适合运行定时任务。 AWS Lambda 适合运行短时间任务，但题目提到的 cron jobs 运行时间可能长达 20 分钟，可能超出 Lambda 的最大执行时间限制（ 15 分钟）。 因此， Lambda 不适合运行这些 cron jobs 。 结论： 错误。
explanations.B: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use AWS Batch on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with a scheduling policy to run the cron jobs. 分析： AWS Batch 适合运行批处理任务，但它主要用于处理大规模并行计算任务，而不是简单的定时任务。 题目要求的是运行 cron jobs ，而不是复杂的批处理任务，因此 AWS Batch 不是最佳选择。 结论： 错误。
explanations.C: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to create a recurring schedule. Run the cron job tasks on AWS Fargate. 分析： Amazon EventBridge Scheduler 可以轻松创建周期性计划，适合运行定时任务。 AWS Fargate 是一种无服务器容器运行服务，支持运行长时间任务，适合运行这些 cron jobs 。 此选项满足题目要求，且支持未来事件触发。 结论： 正确。
explanations.D: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Create a workflow in AWS Step Functions that uses a Wait state to run the cron jobs at a specified time. Use the RunTask action to run the cron job tasks on AWS Fargate. 分析： AWS Step Functions 适合构建复杂的工作流，但题目并未要求复杂的工作流管理。 使用 Wait 状态来实现定时任务的运行效率较低，且不如 EventBridge Scheduler 直接支持定时任务。 虽然可以使用 RunTask 在 AWS Fargate 上运行任务，但整体方案复杂度较高，不符合 “ 最小重构 ” 的要求。 结论： 错误。

question: A company recently migrated its application to AWS. The application runs on Amazon EC2 Linux instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. question: A robotics company is designing a solution for medical surgery. The robots will use advanced sensors, cameras, and AI algorithms to perceive their environment and to complete surgeries. question: A company is planning to migrate data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The data must be encrypted at rest within the S3 bucket. The encryption key must be rotated automatically every year. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate the data to the S3 bucket. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3). Use the built-in key rotation behavior of SSE-S3 encryption keys.
options.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Set the S3 bucket's default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Migrate the data to the S3 bucket.

question: A company is migrating applications from an on-premises Microsoft Active Directory that the company manages to AWS. The company deploys the applications in multiple AWS accounts. question: A financial services company that runs on AWS has designed its security controls to meet industry standards. The industry standards include the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) and the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS). The company's third-party auditors need proof that the designed controls have been implemented and are functioning correctly. The company has hundreds of AWS accounts in a single organization in AWS Organizations. The company needs to monitor the current state of the controls across accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Designate one account as the Amazon Inspector delegated administrator account from the Organizations management account. Integrate Inspector with Organizations to discover and scan resources across all AWS accounts. Enable Inspector industry standards for NIST and PCI DSS.
options.B: Designate one account as the Amazon GuardDuty delegated administrator account from the Organizations management account. In the designated GuardDuty administrator account, enable GuardDuty to protect all member accounts. Enable GuardDuty industry standards for NIST and PCI DSS.
options.C: Configure an AWS CloudTrail organization trail in the Organizations management account. Designate one account as the compliance account. Enable CloudTrail security standards for NIST and PCI DSS in the compliance account.
options.D: Designate one account as the AWS Security Hub delegated administrator account from the Organizations management account. In the designated Security Hub administrator account, enable Security Hub for all member accounts. Enable Security Hub standards for NIST and PCI DSS.

explanations.A: Designate one account as the Amazon Inspector delegated administrator account... Amazon Inspector 主要用于自动化的安全评估和漏洞扫描，但它并不直接提供对行业标准（如 NIST 和 PCI DSS ）的合规性监控。 虽然 Inspector 可以发现和扫描资源，但它的功能不完全覆盖合规性验证的需求，因此此选项不符合题目要求。 错误原因： Inspector 的功能与题目要求的合规性监控不完全匹配。
explanations.B: Designate one account as the Amazon GuardDuty delegated administrator account... Amazon GuardDuty 主要用于威胁检测和异常行为监控，而不是专门设计用于行业标准（如 NIST 和 PCI DSS ）的合规性验证。 GuardDuty 无法直接提供对行业标准的合规性监控，因此此选项不符合题目要求。 错误原因： GuardDuty 的功能侧重于威胁检测，而非合规性验证。
explanations.C: Configure an AWS CloudTrail organization trail... AWS CloudTrail 主要用于记录 API 调用和用户活动日志，但它并不直接提供对行业标准（如 NIST 和 PCI DSS ）的合规性监控。 虽然 CloudTrail 可以帮助审计活动，但它无法直接验证安全控制的实施和功能，因此此选项不符合题目要求。 错误原因： CloudTrail 的功能侧重于日志记录，而非合规性验证。
explanations.D: Designate one account as the AWS Security Hub delegated administrator account... AWS Security Hub 专门设计用于集中管理和监控安全状态，并支持行业标准（如 NIST 和 PCI DSS ）的合规性验证。 Security Hub 可以整合来自多个 AWS 服务的数据，并提供合规性检查功能，因此完全符合题目要求。 正确原因： Security Hub 支持行业标准的合规性验证，并能够集中管理多个账户的安全状态。

question: A company uses Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) to run its self-managed database. The company has 350 TB of data spread across all EBS volumes. The company takes daily EBS snapshots and keeps the snapshots for 1 month. The daily change rate is 5% of the EBS volumes. Because of new regulations, the company needs to keep the monthly snapshots for 7 years. The company needs to change its backup strategy to comply with the new regulations and to ensure that data is available with minimal administrative effort. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Keep the daily snapshot in the EBS snapshot standard tier for 1 month. Copy the monthly snapshot to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive with a 7-year retention period.
options.B: Continue with the current EBS snapshot policy. Add a new policy to move the monthly snapshot to Amazon EBS Snapshots Archive with a 7-year retention period.
options.C: Keep the daily snapshot in the EBS snapshot standard tier for 1 month. Keep the monthly snapshot in the standard tier for 7 years. Use incremental snapshots.
options.D: Keep the daily snapshot in the EBS snapshot standard tier. Use EBS direct APIs to take snapshots of all the EBS volumes every month. Store the snapshots in an Amazon S3 bucket in the Infrequent Access tier for 7 years.

explanations.A: 将每日快照保留在 EBS 快照标准层中 1 个月。将每月快照复制到 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive ，并设置 7 年的保留期。 正确性分析： Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive 是一个极低成本的长期存储选项，但 EBS 快照无法直接复制到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 。需要使用额外的工具或流程（如导出到 S3 ），这增加了复杂性和管理成本。 结论：此选项不符合 “ 最小化管理工作量 ” 的要求。
explanations.B: 继续使用当前的 EBS 快照策略。添加一个新策略，将每月快照移动到 Amazon EBS Snapshots Archive ，并设置 7 年的保留 期。 正确性分析： Amazon EBS Snapshots Archive 是专门为长期存储 EBS 快照设计的低成本选项。此选项直接利用 EBS 的归档功能，符合 成本优化和管理简化的要求。 结论：此选项是正确的。
explanations.C: 将每日快照保留在 EBS 快照标准层中 1 个月。将每月快照保留在标准层中 7 年。使用增量快照。 正确性分析：虽然增量快照可以减少存储成本，但将快照保留在标准层 7 年会导致高昂的存储费用，不符合 “ 成本优化 ” 的要求。 结论：此选项不符合成本效益要求。
explanations.D: 将每日快照保留在 EBS 快照标准层中。使用 EBS direct APIs 每月对所有 EBS 卷进行快照。将快照存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶的 Infrequent Access 层中 7 年。 正确性分析： EBS 快照无法直接存储到 S3 ，需要导出到 S3 ，这增加了管理复杂性。此外， S3 Infrequent Access 层的成本可能高于 EBS Snapshots Archive 。 结论：此选项不符合 “ 最小化管理工作量 ” 的要求。

question: A company uses Amazon S3 to host its static website. The company wants to add a contact form to the webpage. The contact form will have dynamic server-side components for users to input their name, email address, phone number, and user message. The company expects fewer than 100 site visits each month. The contact form must notify the company by email when a customer fills out the form. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Host the dynamic contact form in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to connect to a third-party email provider.
options.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint that returns the contact form from an AWS Lambda function. Configure another Lambda function on the API Gateway to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
options.C: Host the website by using AWS Amplify Hosting for static content and dynamic content. Use server-side scripting to build the contact form. Configure Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to deliver the message to the company.
options.D: Migrate the website from Amazon S3 to Amazon EC2 instances that run Windows Server. Use Internet Information Services (IIS) for Windows Server to host the webpage. Use client-side scripting to build the contact form. Integrate the form with Amazon WorkMail.

explanations.A: Host the dynamic contact form in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to connect to a third-party email provider. 分析： Amazon ECS 是一种孱器服务，辴合辡行复杂的寒用程寏，但孼于每月宆于 100 次访輐的场景来说，嬹本较轸且辟于复杂。 使用 Amazon SES 辩接到第三方电子近件提供商增加了轠外的迚置复杂嬖。 此辷轒不符合 “ 最具嬹本效益 ” 的要求。 结论： 迾误。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint that returns the contact form from an AWS Lambda function. Configure another Lambda function on the API Gateway to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. 分析： Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 是无服务器架构，辴合低流迣场景，嬹本低。 使用 Lambda 函数处理表单提交，寈达辟 Amazon SNS 发辳达知，符合动嬒内孱和达知轀求。 此辷轒孩现简单，且嬹本效益轸。 结论： 正确。
explanations.C: Host the website by using AWS Amplify Hosting for static content and dynamic content. Use server-side scripting to build the contact form. Configure Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to deliver the message to the company. 分析： AWS Amplify Hosting 辴合孋管轆嬒和动嬒内孱，但孼于每月宆于 100 次访輐的场景，可能嬹本较轸。 使用 Amazon SQS 传辻消嬟增加了复杂嬖，且不直接满足 “ 达知公司 ” 的轀求。 此辷轒不符合 “ 最具嬹本效益 ” 的要求。 结论： 迾误。
explanations.D: Migrate the website from Amazon S3 to Amazon EC2 instances that run Windows Server. Use Internet Information Services (IIS) for Windows Server to host the webpage. Use client-side scripting to build the contact form. Integrate the form with Amazon WorkMail. 分析： 宂网站辜移到 Amazon EC2 孩例增加了管理复杂嬖和嬹本。 使用 Windows Server 和 IIS 辟于复杂，不辴合低流迣场景。 此辷轒不符合 “ 最具嬹本效益 ” 的要求。 结论： 迾误。

options.C: Configure each AWS account root user email address to be the individual company managed email address of one person from each business unit. Configure alternate contacts for each AWS account with corresponding distribution lists for the billing team, the security team, and the operations team for each business unit.
options.D: Configure each AWS account root user to use email aliases that go to a centralized mailbox. Configure alternate contacts for each account by using a single business managed email distribution list each for the billing team, the security team, and the operations team.

question: A company runs an ecommerce application on AWS. Amazon EC2 instances process purchases and store the purchase details in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. Customers are experiencing application timeouts during times of peak usage. A solutions architect needs to rearchitect the application so that the application can scale to meet peak usage demands. Which combination of actions will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure an Auto Scaling group of new EC2 instances to retry the purchases until the processing is complete. Update the applications to connect to the DB cluster by using Amazon RDS Proxy.
options.B: Configure the application to use an Amazon ElastiCache cluster in front of the Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.C: Update the application to send the purchase requests to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure an Auto Scaling group of new EC2 instances that read from the SQS queue.
options.D: Configure an AWS Lambda function to retry the ticket purchases until the processing is complete.
options.E: Configure an Amazon AP! Gateway REST API with a usage plan.

explanations.A: 配置一个新的 EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组以重试购买，直到处理完成。更新应用程序以通过 Amazon RDS Proxy 连接到 DB 集群。 正确嬖分析： Auto Scaling 可以动嬒孎宛 EC2 孩例以寒孼高客流量， RDS Proxy 可以优化数据寑连接池，减宆数据寑连接的压力。 适用嬖分析：此选项解决了 EC2 孩例的孎宛问题，同时通过 RDS Proxy 优化了数据寑连接，适用于高客流量场景。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.B: 将应用程序配置为在 Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群前使用 Amazon ElastiCache 集群。 正确嬖分析： ElastiCache 可以缓孓频繁访问的数据，减宆数据寑的查询压力。 适用嬖分析：虽然可以优化数据寑嬖能，但本题场景中涉及的是购买请求的处理，而不是频繁的查询操作，因此 ElastiCache 的作用 有限。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.C: 更新应用程序以将购买请求发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置一个新的 EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组以从 SQS 队列读取。 正确嬖分析： SQS 可以孩现寢步处理，宂购买请求解耦寈孓储在队列中， Auto Scaling 可以动嬒孎宛处理队列的 EC2 孩例。 适用嬖分析：此选项解决了高客流量时的请求处理问题，适用于本题场景。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.D: 配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数以重试票务购买，直到处理完成。 正确嬖分析： Lambda 函数可以孩现无服务器计算，但重试逻辑可能孾致复杂嬖增加，且无法直接解决数据寑连接压力问题。 适用嬖分析：此选项不如 AC 组合有效，且可能增加嬹本和复杂嬖。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.E: 配置一个 Amazon API Gateway REST API 并设置使用计划。 正确嬖分析： API Gateway 的使用计划可以限制流量，但无法直接解决高客流量时的请求处理问题。 适用嬖分析：此选项不适用于本题场景。 结论：此选项错误。 4. 我的答案 嬺选择的答案是： A 和 C 5. 官方答案 季方答案是： A 和 C 正确答案： AC

question: A company that uses AWS Organizations runs 150 applications across 30 different AWS accounts. The company used AWS Cost and Usage Report to create a new report in the management account. The report is delivered to an Amazon S3 bucket that is replicated to a bucket in the data collection account. The company’s senior leadership wants to view a custom dashboard that provides NAT gateway costs each day starting at the beginning of the current month. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure QuickSight to use AWS DataSync to query the new report.
options.B: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure QuickSight to use Amazon Athena to query the new report.
options.C: Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure CloudWatch to use AWS DataSync to query the new report.
options.D: Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure CloudWatch to use Amazon Athena to query the new report.

explanations.A: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure QuickSight to use AWS DataSync to query the new report. 错误： AWS DataSync 主要用于数据迁移和同步，而不是用于查询数据。 QuickSight 无法直接使用 DataSync 来查询 Cost and Usage Report 。
explanations.B: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure QuickSight to use Amazon Athena to query the new report. 正确： Amazon Athena 可以直接查询存储在 S3 中的 Cost and Usage Report 。 QuickSight 可以通过 Athena 作为数据源来创建可视化仪 表板。
explanations.C: Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure CloudWatch to use AWS DataSync to query the new report. 错误： CloudWatch 主要用于监控和日志分析，不适合用于查询 Cost and Usage Report 。此外， DataSync 不支持查询功能。

question: A company is hosting a high-traffic static website on Amazon S3 with an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has a default TTL of 0 seconds. The company wants to implement caching to improve performance for the website. However, the company also wants to ensure that stale content is not served for more than a few minutes after a deployment. Which combination of caching methods should a solutions architect implement to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Set the CloudFront default TTL to 2 minutes.
options.B: Set a default TTL of 2 minutes on the S3 bucket.
options.C: Add a Cache-Control private directive to the objects in Amazon S3.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda@Edge function to add an Expires header to HTTP responses. Configure the function to run on viewer response.
options.E: Add a Cache-Control max-age directive of 24 hours to the objects in Amazon S3. On deployment, create a CloudFront invalidation to clear any changed files from edge caches.

explanations.A: Set the CloudFront default TTL to 2 minutes. 正确：将 CloudFront 的默认 TTL 设置为 2 分钟可以确保内容在边缘位置缓存一段时间，从而提高性能。 同时， TTL 的设置较短（ 2 分钟）可以减少 stale 内容的时间，符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Set a default TTL of 2 minutes on the S3 bucket. 错误： S3 本身不支持直接设置 TTL 。 TTL 是 CloudFront 的功能，而不是 S3 的功能。
explanations.C: Add a Cache-Control private directive to the objects in Amazon S3. 错误： Cache-Control private 指令会告诉缓存服务器不要缓存内容，这与题目要求的 “ 实现缓存以提高性能 ” 相矛盾。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Lambda@Edge function to add an Expires header to HTTP responses. Configure the function to run on viewer response. 错误：虽然可以通过 Lambda@Edge 添加 Expires 头，但这会增加复杂性，且题目没有明确要求使用 Lambda@Edge 。
explanations.E: Add a Cache-Control max-age directive of 24 hours to the objects in Amazon S3. On deployment, create a CloudFront invalidation to clear any changed files from edge caches. 正确： Cache-Control max-age 指令可以设置对象的缓存时间为 24 小时，从而提高性能。 通过 CloudFront invalidation ，可以在部署时清除已更改的文件，确保 stale 内容不会被长时间缓存。 3. 我选的答案 A E 4. 官方答案 A E 5. 与官方答案的比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 没有需要重新思考的地方。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 淘孨 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 嬄信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

question: A company has deployed a multi-account strategy on AWS by using AWS Control Tower. The company has provided individual AWS accounts to each of its developers. question: A solutions architect is designing a three-tier web application. question: A company plans to rehost an application to Amazon EC2 instances that use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) as the attached storage. question: A company is migrating five on-premises applications to VPCs in the AWS Cloud. Each application is currently deployed in isolated virtual networks on premises and should be deployed similarly in the AWS Cloud. The applications need to reach a shared services VPC. All the applications must be able to communicate with each other. If the migration is successful, the company will repeat the migration process for more than 100 applications. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.B: Deploy VPC peering connections between the application VPCs and the shared services VPC. Add routes between the application VPCs in their subnets to the shared services VPC through the peering connection.
options.C: Deploy an AWS Direct Connect connection between the application VPCs and the shared services VPAdd routes from the application VPCs in their subnets to the shared services VPC and the applications VPCs. Add routes from the shared services VPC subnets to the applications VPCs.

explanations.B: 部署 VPC Peering 连接： 正确嬖： VPC Peering 可以孩现 VPC 之间的通信，但需要为每个 VPC 孼孅动创寠孼等连接。 错误原因：随着寒用程寏数量增加， VPC Peering 连接的数量会呈指数级增长，管理寡销非寀高，不适合大规模场景。
explanations.C: 部署 AWS Direct Connect 连接： 正确嬖： AWS Direct Connect 主要用于连接本地数据中嬇和 AWS 云，而不是用于 VPC 之间的通信。 错误原因： Direct Connect 不适合解决 VPC 之间的通信问题，且嬹本较高，无法满足题目要求。
explanations.D: 部署 Transit Gateway ： 正确嬖： Transit Gateway 是专为大规模 VPC 通信设计的服务，可以轻松管理多个 VPC 之间的连接。 正确原因： Transit Gateway 支持集中寥路由管理，减宆了孅动配置的复杂嬖，且非寀适合超过 100 个寒用程寏的场景。

question: A company wants to improve the availability and performance of its hybrid application. The application consists of a stateful TCP- based workload hosted on Amazon EC2 instances in different AWS Regions and a stateless UDP-based workload hosted on premises. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to improve availability and performance? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an accelerator using AWS Global Accelerator. Add the load balancers as endpoints.
options.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin that uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to the load balancers.
options.C: Configure two Application Load Balancers in each Region. The first will route to the EC2 endpoints, and the second will route to the on-premises endpoints.
options.D: Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region to address the EC2 endpoints. Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region that routes to the on-premises endpoints.
options.E: Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region to address the EC2 endpoints. Configure an Application Load Balancer in each Region that routes to the on-premises endpoints.

explanations.A: Create an accelerator using AWS Global Accelerator. Add the load balancers as endpoints. 正确。 AWS Global Accelerator 可以通过优化路由来提高跨区域应用的性能和可用性。将负载均衡器作为端点可以支持跨区域流量管 理。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin that uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to the load balancers. 错误。 CloudFront 主要用于内容分发（ CDN ），而题目中的应用是基于 TCP 和 UDP 的工作负载， CloudFront 不适合处理这种类型的 流量。
explanations.C: Configure two Application Load Balancers in each Region. The first will route to the EC2 endpoints, and the second will route to the on-premises endpoints. 错误。 Application Load Balancer 主要用于 HTTP/HTTPS 流量，而题目中的工作负载是基于 TCP 和 UDP 的，使用 ALB 不合适。
explanations.D: Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region to address the EC2 endpoints. Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region that routes to the on-premises endpoints. 正确。 Network Load Balancer 支持 TCP 和 UDP 流量，适合处理题目中的工作负载。配置 NLB 可以提高可用性和性能。
explanations.E: Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region to address the EC2 endpoints. Configure an Application Load Balancer in each Region that routes to the on-premises endpoints. 错误。虽然 NLB 适合处理 EC2 端点的 TCP/UDP 流量，但 ALB 不适合处理本地端点的 TCP/UDP 流量。

question: A company recently performed a lift and shift migration of its on-premises Oracle database workload to run on an Amazon EC2 memory optimized Linux instance. The EC2 Linux instance uses a 1 TB Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume with 64,000 IOPS. The database storage performance after the migration is slower than the performance of the on-premises database. Which solution will improve storage performance?

options.A: Add more Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volumes. Use OS commands to create a Logical Volume Management (LVM) stripe.
options.B: Increase the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume to more than 64,000 IOPS.
options.C: Increase the size of the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume to 2 TB.
options.D: Change the EC2 Linux instance to a storage optimized instance type. Do not change the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume.

explanations.A: Add more Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volumes. Use OS commands to create a Logical Volume Management (LVM) stripe. 正确：通过添加更多的 io1 卷并使用 LVM 条带化，可以实现并行读写操作，从而显著提高存储性能。 条带化是一种常见的性能优化技术，尤其适用于高性能数据库工作负载。
explanations.B: Increase the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume to more than 64,000 IOPS. 错误：单个 io1 卷的最大 IOPS 限制为 64,000 （在 Nitro 系统上为 256,000 ），因此无法通过增加 IOPS 超过 64,000 来解决问题。 即使增加 IOPS 到最大值，也可能无法满足数据库的性能需求。
explanations.C: Increase the size of the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume to 2 TB. 错误：增加卷的大小不会直接提高 IOPS 性能。 IOPS 与卷大小相关，但问题的核心是性能不足，而不是存储容量不足。
explanations.D: Change the EC2 Linux instance to a storage optimized instance type. Do not change the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume. 错误：存储优化实例类型（如 I3 或 I3en ）通常使用本地 NVMe 存储，而不是 EBS 卷。如果继续使用 EBS 卷，改变实例类型不会显著提 高性能。 问题的核心在于 EBS 卷的性能，而不是实例类型。 3. 我的答案 A 4. 官方答案 A 5. 与官方答案的比较 我的答案与官方答案一致，无需重新思考。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 淘宝 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

question: A company is migrating from a monolithic architecture for a web application that is hosted on Amazon EC2 to a serverless microservices architecture. The company wants to use AWS services that support an event-driven, loosely coupled architecture. The company wants to use the publish/subscribe (pub/sub) pattern. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure one or more subscribers to read events from the SQS queue.
options.B: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the SNS topic.
options.C: Configure an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API to write to a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with enhanced fan-out. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the data stream.
options.D: Configure an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the topic.

explanations.A: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure one or more subscribers to read events from the SQS queue. 正确性分析： Amazon SQS 是一个队列服务，适合点对点消息传递，而不是 Pub/Sub 模式。虽然可以通过多个消费者读取队列中的消 息，但它不完全符合 Pub/Sub 的设计模式。 成本分析： 使用 SQS 可能会增加成本，因为需要额外的队列管理和消息轮询。 结论： 不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the SNS topic. 正确性分析： Amazon SNS 是一个 Pub/Sub 服务，支持事件驱动架构和多个订阅者。此选项符合题目要求。 成本分析： 使用 REST API 可能会增加成本，因为 REST API 的调用费用较高。 结论： 虽然符合要求，但不是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.C: Configure an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API to write to a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with enhanced fan-out. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the data stream. 正确性分析： Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 适合实时数据流处理，但它的主要用途是高吞吐量数据流，而不是事件驱动的 Pub/Sub 模式。 成本分析： Kinesis Data Streams 的成本较高，尤其是启用增强型扇出功能时。 结论： 不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the topic. 正确性分析： Amazon SNS 是一个 Pub/Sub 服务，支持事件驱动架构和多个订阅者。 HTTP API 的成本比 REST API 更低，符合题目要 求。 成本分析： HTTP API 的调用费用较低，是最具成本效益的解决方案。 结论： 符合题目要求，是最佳答案。

question: A company recently migrated a monolithic application to an Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon RDS. The application has tightly coupled modules. The existing design of the application gives the application the ability to run on only a single EC2 instance. The company has noticed high CPU utilization on the EC2 instance during peak usage times. The high CPU utilization corresponds to degraded performance on Amazon RDS for read requests. The company wants to reduce the high CPU utilization and improve read request performance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Configure an RDS read replica for read requests.
options.B: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Add an RDS read replica and redirect all read/write traffic to the replica.
options.C: Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum size of 1 and maximum size of 2. Resize the RDS DB instance to an instance type that has more CPU capacity.
options.D: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Resize the RDS DB instance to an instance type that has more CPU capacity.

explanations.A: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Configure an RDS read replica for read requests. 正确：调整 EC2 实例以增加 CPU 容量可以解决高 CPU 利用率问题。 正确：配置 Auto Scaling 组的最小和最大大小为 1 ，确保单实例运行符合当前应用的设计限制。 正确：添加 RDS 读副本可以分担读请求负载，从而提高数据库性能。
explanations.B: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Add an RDS read replica and redirect all read/write traffic to the replica. 错误： RDS 读副本仅用于处理读请求，不能处理写请求。将所有读 / 写流量重定向到读副本是不正确的。 正确：调整 EC2 实例以增加 CPU 容量可以解决高 CPU 利用率问题。 正确：配置 Auto Scaling 组的最小和最大大小为 1 ，符合当前应用的设计限制。
explanations.C: Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum size of 1 and maximum size of 2. Resize the RDS DB instance to an instance type that has more CPU capacity. 错误：当前应用设计为只能运行在单个 EC2 实例上，因此 Auto Scaling 组的最大大小设置为 2 不符合要求。 正确：调整 RDS 实例以增加 CPU 容量可以提高数据库性能，但没有解决读请求的分担问题。
explanations.D: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Resize the RDS DB instance to an instance type that has more CPU capacity. 正确：调整 EC2 实例以增加 CPU 容量可以解决高 CPU 利用率问题。 正确：配置 Auto Scaling 组的最小和最大大小为 1 ，符合当前应用的设计限制。 错误：调整 RDS 实例以增加 CPU 容量可以提高性能，但没有解决读请求的分担问题。相比之下，使用 RDS 读副本更适合解决读请求 性能问题。

question: A company needs to grant a team of developers access to the company's AWS resources. The company must maintain a high level of security for the resources. The company requires an access control solution that will prevent unauthorized access to the sensitive data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Share the IAM user credentials for each development team member with the rest of the team to simplify access management and to streamline development workflows.
options.B: Define IAM roles that have fine-grained permissions based on the principle of least privilege. Assign an IAM role to each developer.
options.C: Create IAM access keys to grant programmatic access to AWS resources. Allow only developers to interact with AWS resources through API calls by using the access keys.
options.D: Create an AWS Cognito user pool. Grant developers access to AWS resources by using the user pool.

explanations.B: Define IAM roles that have fine-grained permissions based on the principle of least privilege. Assign an IAM role to each developer. 正确：基于最小权限原则定义 IAM 角色是 AWS 推荐的最佳实践。 正确： IAM 角色可以提供细粒度的权限控制，并且可以通过临时凭证安全地访问资源。
explanations.C: Create IAM access keys to grant programmatic access to AWS resources. Allow only developers to interact with AWS resources through API calls by using the access keys. 错误：虽然可以通过访问密钥进行编程访问，但长期使用静态访问密钥存在安全风险。 错误：无法实现基于最小权限的细粒度控制。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Cognito user pool. question: A company hosts a video streaming web application in a VPC. The company uses a Network Load Balancer (NLB) to handle TCP traffic for real-time data processing.
