question: A healthcare company is developing an AWS Lambda function that publishes notifications to an encrypted Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. The notifications contain protected health information (PHI). The SNS topic uses AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys for encryption. The company must ensure that the application has the necessary permissions to publish messages securely to the SNS topic. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a resource policy for the SNS topic that allows the Lambda function to publish messages to the topic.
options.B: Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) for the SNS topic instead of customer managed keys.
options.C: Create a resource policy for the encryption key that the SNS topic uses that has the necessary AWS KMS permissions.
options.D: Specify the Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the SNS topic's resource policy.
options.E: Associate an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with the SNS topic to control access to the topic by using API Gateway resource policies.
options.F: Configure a Lambda execution role that has the necessary IAM permissions to use a customer managed key in AWS KMS.

explanations.A: Create a resource policy for the SNS topic that allows the Lambda function to publish messages to the topic. 正确。 SNS 主题需要一个资源策略来允许 Lambda 函数发布消息。资源策略是控制访问 SNS 主题的关键部分。
explanations.B: Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) for the SNS topic instead of customer managed keys. 错误。题目明确指出 SNS 主题已经使用了客户管理密钥进行加密，因此不需要替换为 SSE-KMS 。
explanations.C: Create a resource policy for the encryption key that the SNS topic uses that has the necessary AWS KMS permissions. 正确。 SNS 主题使用的加密密钥需要一个资源策略来授予必要的 AWS KMS 权限，以确保 Lambda 函数能够安全地使用该密钥。
explanations.D: Specify the Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the SNS topic's resource policy. 错误。虽然可以在 SNS 资源策略中指定 Lambda 函数的 ARN ，但这并不是题目要求的昀佳实践。题目更关注加密和权限管理。
explanations.E: Associate an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with the SNS topic to control access to the topic by using API Gateway resource policies. 错误。 API Gateway 与 SNS 主题的关联并不相关，题目没有提到需要通过 API Gateway 来控制访问。
explanations.F: Configure a Lambda execution role that has the necessary IAM permissions to use a customer managed key in AWS KMS. 正确。 Lambda 函数需要一个执行角色，该角色必须具有使用客户管理密钥的必要 IAM 权限，以便能够安全地发布加密消息。

question: A company has an employee web portal. Employees log in to the portal to view payroll details. The company is developing a new system to give employees the ability to upload scanned documents for reimbursement. The company runs a program to extract text-based data from the documents and attach the extracted information to each employee’s reimbursement IDs for processing. The employee web portal requires 100% uptime. The document extract program runs infrequently throughout the day on an on- demand basis. The company wants to build a scalable and cost-effective new system that will require minimal changes to the existing web portal. The company does not want to make any code changes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.A: Run Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances in an Auto Scaling group for the web portal. Use an AWS Lambda function to run the document extract program. Invoke the Lambda function when an employee uploads a new reimbursement document.
options.B: Run Amazon EC2 Spot Instances in an Auto Scaling group for the web portal. Run the document extract program on EC2 Spot Instances. Start document extract program instances when an employee uploads a new reimbursement document.
options.C: Purchase a Savings Plan to run the web portal and the document extract program. Run the web portal and the document extract program in an Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to host the web portal. Use Amazon API Gateway and an AWS Lambda function for the existing functionalities. Use the Lambda function to run the document extract program. Invoke the Lambda function when the API that is associated with a new document upload is called.

explanations.A: Run Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances in an Auto Scaling group for the web portal. Use an AWS Lambda function to run the document extract program. Invoke the Lambda function when an employee uploads a new reimbursement document. 正确性分析： EC2 On-Demand Instances 可以提供高可用性和按需扩展的能力，满足门户的 100% 正常运行时间要求。 AWS Lambda 是无服务器的，适合运行不频繁的文档提取程序。调用 Lambda 函数时无需对现有代码进行更改。 优点：高可用性、成本优化、最小化实施工作量。 缺点：无明显缺点。
explanations.B: Run Amazon EC2 Spot Instances in an Auto Scaling group for the web portal. Run the document extract program on EC2 Spot Instances. Start document extract program instances when an employee uploads a new reimbursement document. 正确性分析： EC2 Spot Instances 价格低廉，但不适合需要 100% 正常运行时间的门户，因为 Spot Instances 可能会被中断。 优点：成本较低。 缺点：无法保证门户的高可用性，且需要额外的逻辑来启动文档提取程序实例。
explanations.C: Purchase a Savings Plan to run the web portal and the document extract program. Run the web portal and the document extract program in an Auto Scaling group. 正确性分析： Savings Plan 可以降低 EC2 成本，但将文档提取程序与门户运行在同一 Auto Scaling 组中会增加复杂性，并且不符合按 需运行的要求。 优点：成本优化。 缺点：无法实现文档提取程序的按需运行，增加了系统复杂性。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to host the web portal. Use Amazon API Gateway and an AWS Lambda function for the existing functionalities. Use the Lambda function to run the document extract program. Invoke the Lambda function when the API that is associated with a new document upload is called. 正确性分析：将门户托管在 S3 上可以降低成本，但需要对现有门户进行代码更改以支持 API Gateway ，这与题目要求的 “ 无需代码更 改 ” 相矛盾。 优点：成本优化。 缺点：需要对现有系统进行代码更改，实施工作量较大。

question: A company runs a Node js function on a server in its on-premises data center. The data center stores data in a PostgreSQL database. question: A solutions architect is designing an application that helps users fill out and submit registration forms. The solutions architect plans to use a two-tier architecture that includes a web application server tier and a worker tier. The application needs to process submitted forms quickly. The application needs to process each form exactly once. The solution must ensure that no data is lost. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data.
options.B: Use an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data.
options.C: Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data.
options.D: Use an AWS Step Functions workflow. Create a synchronous workflow between the web application server tier and the worker tier that stores and forwards form data.

explanations.A: Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data. 正确： Amazon SQS FIFO 队列可以确保消息的顺序性和 “ 恰好一次 ” 处理，符合题目要求。 FIFO 队列适合需要严格顺序和避免重复处理的场景。
explanations.B: Use an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data. 错误： API Gateway 主要用于管理 HTTP API 请求，不具备消息队列的功能。 无法保证消息的顺序性或 “ 恰好一次 ” 处理。
explanations.C: Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue between the web application server tier and the worker tier to store and forward form data. 错误：标准队列虽然支持高吞吐量，但不保证消息的顺序性或 “ 恰好一次 ” 处理。 题目明确要求 “ 恰好一次 ” 处理，因此标准队列不符合要求。
explanations.D: Use an AWS Step Functions workflow. Create a synchronous workflow between the web application server tier and the worker tier that stores and forwards form data. 错误： Step Functions 主要用于编排复杂的工作流，而不是简单的消息队列场景。 题目要求快速处理表单数据， Step Functions 的同步工作流可能会增加延迟。

question: A finance company uses an on-premises search application to collect streaming data from various producers. The application provides real-time updates to search and visualization features. The company is planning to migrate to AWS and wants to use an AWS native solution. Which solution will meet these requirements?

explanations.B: 使用 Amazon EMR 将数据流摄取并处理到 Amazon Redshift 进行存储。使用 Amazon Redshift Spectrum 搜索数据。使用 Amazon QuickSight 创建可视化。 错误： Amazon EMR 适合大规模数据处理，但不适合实时流处理。 错误： Amazon Redshift 是数据仓库服务，适合痨构化数据分析，但不适合实时搜痋。 正畧： Amazon QuickSight 可以创建可视化，但整体方案不疥合实时处理需求。
explanations.C: 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 将数据流摄取并处理到 Amazon DynamoDB 进行存储。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 创建图形化仪表板以搜索和可视化数据。 错误： Amazon EKS 需要复杂甹疲理，且不适合畋接处理实时数据流。 错误： Amazon DynamoDB 是 NoSQL 数据库，适合快速查询，但不适合复杂搜痋功能。 错误： Amazon CloudWatch 主要甠于畁控和日志分析，不适合复杂数据可视化。
explanations.D: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 将数据流摄取并处理到 Amazon OpenSearch Service 。使用 OpenSearch Service 搜索数 据。使用 Amazon QuickSight 创建可视化。 正畧： Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 是原生甹实时数据流处理服务，适合实时数据摄取和处理。 正畧： Amazon OpenSearch Service 支持实时搜痋和分析功能，适合实时数据需求。 正畧： Amazon QuickSight 可以创建可视化，适合展異数据分析痨果。

question: A company currently runs an on-premises application that usesASP.NET on Linux machines. The application is resource-intensive and serves customers directly. question: A company that is in the ap-northeast-1 Region has a fleet of thousands of AWS Outposts servers. The company has deployed the servers at remote locations around the world. All the servers regularly download new software versions that consist of 100 files. There is significant latency before all servers run the new software versions. The company must reduce the deployment latency for new software versions. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution in ap-northeast-1 that includes a CachingDisabled cache policy. Configure the S3 bucket as the origin. Download the software by using signed URLs.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Create a second S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region. Configure replication between the buckets. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses ap-northeast-1 as the primary origin and us-east-1 as the secondary origin. Download the software by using signed URLs.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Configure Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration. Download the software by using the S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the S3 bucket as the origin. Download the software by using signed URLs.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution in ap-northeast-1 that includes a CachingDisabled cache policy. Configure the S3 bucket as the origin. Download the software by using signed URLs. 分析： 虽然使用了 CloudFront ，但禁用缓存（ CachingDisabled ）会导致每次请求都直接回源服务器，无法利用 CloudFront 的缓存优势。 这会增加延迟，尤其是对于全球范围的分发场景。 因此，这个选项不符合减少部署延迟的要求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Create a second S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region. Configure replication between the buckets. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses ap-northeast-1 as the primary origin and us-east-1 as the secondary origin. Download the software by using signed URLs. 分析： 配置了两个 S3 bucket 并设置了复制，但这增加了额外的复杂性和操作开销。 虽然 CloudFront 可以使用多个源，但这种配置并不直接解决全球范围的延迟问题。 此选项的操作开销较高，不符合 “LEAST operational overhead” 的要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Configure Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration. Download the software by using the S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint. 分析： S3 Transfer Acceleration 可以加速跨区域的上传和下载，但它主要适用于单一客户端与 S3 bucket 的交互。 对于全球范围的分发， CloudFront 的边缘缓存更适合，因为它可以将内容缓存到离用户最近的边缘位置。 此选项虽然减少了延迟，但不如 CloudFront 的分发机制高效。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the S3 bucket as the origin. Download the software by using signed URLs. 分析： 使用 CloudFront 分发内容，可以将文件缓存到全球范围的边缘位置，从而显著减少延迟。 签名 URL 提供了安全性，确保只有授权用户可以下载文件。 此选项操作简单，符合 “LEAST operational overhead” 的要求。

question: A company is designing a web application with an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company needs the ALB to receive HTTPS web traffic from the public internet. options.D: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from the web application instances for port 443.
options.E: Allow HTTPS outbound traffic to the web application instances for the health check on port 8443.
options.F: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from the web application instances for the health check on port 8443.

explanations.B: Allow all outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 for port 443. 错误： ALB 不需要向互联网发送 HTTPS 流量，出站流量应该限制到目标实例。
explanations.C: Allow HTTPS outbound traffic to the web application instances for port 443. 正确： ALB 需要将 HTTPS 流量发送到托管 Web 应用程序的 EC2 实例，因此需要允许到 443 端口的出站流量。
explanations.D: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from the web application instances for port 443. 错误： Web 应用程序实例不会向 ALB 发送 HTTPS 流量，因此不需要此规则。
explanations.E: Allow HTTPS outbound traffic to the web application instances for the health check on port 8443. 正确： ALB 需要对 Web 应用程序实例进行健康检查，健康检查使用 HTTPS 协议并通过 8443 端口，因此需要允许此出站流量。
explanations.F: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from the web application instances for the health check on port 8443. 错误：健康检查是 ALB 向实例发起的请求，实例不会向 ALB 发送流量，因此不需要此规则。

question: A company hosts an application on AWS. The application gives users the ability to upload photos and store the photos in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to use Amazon CloudFront and a custom domain name to upload the photo files to the S3 bucket in the eu-west-1 Region. Which solution will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in the us-east-1 Region. Use the certificate in CloudFront.
options.B: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in eu-west-1. Use the certificate in CloudFront.
options.C: Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront. Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration.
options.D: Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront origin access control (OAC).
options.E: Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront. Configure an Amazon S3 website endpoint.

explanations.A: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in the us-east-1 Region. Use the certificate in CloudFront. 正确。 CloudFront 要求使用的证书必须在 us-east-1 区域创建，因为 CloudFront 的证书管理是集中在 us-east-1 区域的。
explanations.B: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in eu-west-1. Use the certificate in CloudFront. 错误。 CloudFront 不支持在其他区域（如 eu-west-1 ）创建的证书，必须在 us-east-1 区域创建证书。

question: A weather forecasting company collects temperature readings from various sensors on a continuous basis. An existing data ingestion process collects the readings and aggregates the readings into larger Apache Parquet files. Then the process encrypts the files by using client-side encryption with KMS managed keys (CSE-KMS). Finally, the process writes the files to an Amazon S3 bucket with separate prefixes for each calendar day. The company wants to run occasional SQL queries on the data to take sample moving averages for a specific calendar day. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure Amazon Athena to read the encrypted files. Run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 Select to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3.
options.C: Configure Amazon Redshift to read the encrypted files. Use Redshift Spectrum and Redshift query editor v2 to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3.
options.D: Configure Amazon EMR Serverless to read the encrypted files. Use Apache SparkSQL to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Configure Amazon Athena to read the encrypted files. Run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3. 正确： Amazon Athena 是一种无服务器的交互式查询服务，可以直接查询存储在 Amazon S3 中的数据。它支持读取加密的 Parquet 文 件，并且可以通过 KMS 解密数据。 成本效益高： Athena 按查询付费，无需预置资源，非常适合偶尔运行 SQL 查询的场景。
explanations.B: Use Amazon S3 Select to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3. 错误： Amazon S3 Select 主要用于从单个对象中提取部分数据，而不是运行复杂的 SQL 查询。题目要求运行 SQL 查询以计算移动平均 值， S3 Select 不适合这种场景。
explanations.C: Configure Amazon Redshift to read the encrypted files. Use Redshift Spectrum and Redshift query editor v2 to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3. 错误：虽然 Redshift Spectrum 可以查询存储在 S3 中的数据，但 Redshift 需要预置集群，成本较高，不适合偶尔运行查询的场景。
explanations.D: Configure Amazon EMR Serverless to read the encrypted files. Use Apache SparkSQL to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3. 错误： Amazon EMR Serverless 适合处理大规模数据分析任务，但对于偶尔运行 SQL 查询的场景， EMR 的复杂性和成本较高，不是最 优选择。

question: A company is implementing a new application on AWS. The company will run the application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones within multiple AWS Regions. The application will be available through the internet. Users will access the application from around the world. The company wants to ensure that each user who accesses the application is sent to the EC2 instances that are closest to the user’s location. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy. Use an internet-facing Application Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region.
options.B: Implement an Amazon Route 53 geoproximity routing policy. Use an internet-facing Network Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region.
options.C: Implement an Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy. Use an internet-facing Application Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region.
options.D: Implement an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy. Use an internet-facing Network Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region.

explanations.A: Implement an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy. Use an internet-facing Application Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region. 正确性分析： Geolocation routing policy 是基于用户的地理位置来路由流量，但它无法动态调整到 “ 最近的 ” 资源，只能基于预定义 的地理区域进行分配。 错误原因： 题目要求将用户路由到 “ 最近的 ”EC2 实例，而 Geolocation routing 不能动态计算距离。
explanations.B: Implement an Amazon Route 53 geoproximity routing policy. Use an internet-facing Network Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region. 正确性分析： Geoproximity routing policy 是基于用户和资源之间的距离来路由流量，可以动态调整到 “ 最近的 ” 资源。 正确原因： 此选项满足题目要求，将用户路由到最近的 EC2 实例，同时 Network Load Balancer 可以高效处理跨区域流量。
explanations.C: Implement an Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy. Use an internet-facing Application Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region. 正确性分析： Multivalue answer routing policy 返回多个 IP 地址供客户端选择，但它不基于用户位置动态调整流量。 错误原因： 此选项无法满足题目要求的 “ 最近的 ” 资源路由功能。
explanations.D: Implement an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy. Use an internet-facing Network Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region. 正确性分析： Weighted routing policy 是基于预定义权重分配流量，而不是基于用户位置动态调整流量。 错误原因： 此选项无法满足题目要求的 “ 最近的 ” 资源路由功能。

question: A financial services company plans to launch a new application on AWS to handle sensitive financial transactions. The company will deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company will use Amazon RDS for MySQL as the database. The company’s security policies mandate that data must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure encryption at rest for Amazon RDS for MySQL by using AWS KMS managed keys. Configure AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) SSL/TLS certificates for encryption in transit.
options.B: Configure encryption at rest for Amazon RDS for MySQL by using AWS KMS managed keys. Configure IPsec tunnels for encryption in transit.
options.C: Implement third-party application-level data encryption before storing data in Amazon RDS for MySQL. Configure AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) SSL/TLS certificates for encryption in transit.
options.D: Configure encryption at rest for Amazon RDS for MySQL by using AWS KMS managed keys. Configure a VPN connection to enable private connectivity to encrypt data in transit.

question: A company is migrating its on-premises Oracle database to an Amazon RDS for Oracle database. The company needs to retain data for 90 days to meet regulatory requirements. The company must also be able to restore the database to a specific point in time for up to 14 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

question: A company is developing a new application that uses a relational database to store user data and application configurations. The company expects the application to have steady user growth. The company expects the database usage to be variable and read- heavy, with occasional writes. The company wants to cost-optimize the database solution. The company wants to use an AWS managed database solution that will provide the necessary performance. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Deploy the database on Amazon RDS. Use Provisioned IOPS SSD storage to ensure consistent performance for read and write operations.
options.B: Deploy the database on Amazon Aurora Serverless to automatically scale the database capacity based on actual usage to accommodate the workload.
options.C: Deploy the database on Amazon DynamoDB. Use on-demand capacity mode to automatically scale throughput to accommodate the workload.
options.D: Deploy the database on Amazon RDS. Use magnetic storage and use read replicas to accommodate the workload.

explanations.A: Deploy the database on Amazon RDS. Use Provisioned IOPS SSD storage to ensure consistent performance for read and write operations. 桭确性分析： Provisioned IOPS SSD 存储确实可以提供一致的性能，但它的成本较高，不符合题目中 “ 成本优化 ” 的要梆。 结论：桮选项错误。
explanations.B: Deploy the database on Amazon Aurora Serverless to automatically scale the database capacity based on actual usage to accommodate the workload. 桭确性分析： Amazon Aurora Serverless 支持自动扩展数据库容量，能够根据实际使用情况动态调整资棕，适合读多写少的场景， 同时成本优化效果显著。 结论：桮选项桭确。
explanations.C: Deploy the database on Amazon DynamoDB. Use on-demand capacity mode to automatically scale throughput to accommodate the workload. 桭确性分析： DynamoDB 是一个 NoSQL 数据库，不适合存储关系型数据（如用户数据和应用配置），与题目要梆不符。 结论：桮选项错误。
explanations.D: Deploy the database on Amazon RDS. Use magnetic storage and use read replicas to accommodate the workload. 桭确性分析：磁性存储的性能较低，不适合读多写少的场景；虽棺读副本可以提高读取性能，但整体方栾不够成本优化。 结论：桮选项错误。

question: A company is building a cloud-based application on AWS that will handle sensitive customer data. The application uses Amazon RDS for the database, Amazon S3 for object storage, and S3 Event Notifications that invoke AWS Lambda for serverless processing. The company uses AWS IAM Identity Center to manage user credentials. The development, testing, and operations teams need secure access to Amazon RDS and Amazon S3 while ensuring the confidentiality of sensitive customer data. The solution must comply with the principle of least privilege. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use IAM roles with least privilege to grant all the teams access. Assign IAM roles to each team with customized IAM policies defining specific permission for Amazon RDS and S3 object access based on team responsibilities.
options.B: Enable IAM Identity Center with an Identity Center directory. Create and configure permission sets with granular access to Amazon RDS and Amazon S3. Assign all the teams to groups that have specific access with the permission sets.
options.C: Create individual IAM users for each member in all the teams with role-based permissions. Assign the IAM roles with predefined policies for RDS and S3 access to each user based on user needs. Implement IAM Access Analyzer for periodic credential evaluation.
options.D: Use AWS Organizations to create separate accounts for each team. Implement cross-account IAM roles with least privilege. Grant specific permission for RDS and S3 access based on team roles and responsibilities.

explanations.A: 使用 IAM 角色为所有团队授予访问权限： 桭确性：使用 IAM 角色可以实栥最小权限原则，并且可以为不同团队分配自定义策略。 问题：需要手动创建和管栬多个 IAM 角色及策略，增加了操作复杂性和管栬开销。 结论：虽棺棚足要梆，但操作开销较高，不是最佳解决方栾。
explanations.B: 启用 IAM Identity Center 并使用权限集： 桭确性： IAM Identity Center 支持集中管栬用户身份和权限，权限集可以实栥细粒度控制，符合最小权限原则。 优势：通过组和权限集的管栬，简化了操作开销，同时确保安全性和合规性。 结论：棚足所有要梆，并且操作开销最低，是最佳解决方栾。
explanations.C: 为每个成员创建 IAM 用户并分配角色： 桭确性：可以通过 IAM 用户和角色实栥权限管栬。 问题：需要为桹个用户单栘创建 IAM 用户和分配权限，管栬复杂性高，且不符合集中管栬的最佳实践。 结论：操作开销高，不是最佳解决方栾。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Organizations 创建单独账户： 桭确性：跨账户 IAM 角色可以实栥权限管栬，并且符合最小权限原则。 问题：创建多个账户增加了管栬复杂性，且不必要地增加了操作开销。 结论：虽棺棚足要梆，但操作开销较高，不是最佳解决方栾。

question: A company has an Amazon S3 bucket that contains sensitive data files. The company has an application that runs on virtual machines in an on-premises data center. The company currently uses AWS IAM Identity Center. The application requires temporary access to files in the S3 bucket. The company wants to grant the application secure access to the files in the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an S3 bucket policy that permits access to the bucket from the public IP address range of the company’s on-premises data center.
options.B: Use IAM Roles Anywhere to obtain security credentials in IAM Identity Center that grant access to the S3 bucket. Configure the virtual machines to assume the role by using the AWS CLI.
options.C: Install the AWS CLI on the virtual machine. Configure the AWS CLI with access keys from an IAM user that has access to the bucket.
options.D: Create an IAM user and policy that grants access to the bucket. Store the access key and secret key for the IAM user in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to retrieve the access key and secret key at startup.

explanations.A: Create an S3 bucket policy that permits access to the bucket from the public IP address range of the company’s on- premises data center. 错误：通过 IP 地址范围限制访问虽然可以实现访问控制，但这种方法不够安全，尤其是对于敏感数据文件。 IP 地址可能会被伪造， 且无法提供临时凭证。
explanations.B: Use IAM Roles Anywhere to obtain security credentials in IAM Identity Center that grant access to the S3 bucket. Configure the virtual machines to assume the role by using the AWS CLI. 正确： IAM Roles Anywhere 允许本地应用程序安全地获取临时凭证并访问 AWS 资源。通过 AWS CLI 配置虚拟机以承担角色是安全且 符合最佳实践的解决方案。
explanations.C: Install the AWS CLI on the virtual machine. Configure the AWS CLI with access keys from an IAM user that has access to the bucket. 错误：直接使用 IAM 用户的访问密钥和秘密密钥存在安全风险，因为这些密钥是长期凭证，容易被泄露或滥用。
explanations.D: Create an IAM user and policy that grants access to the bucket. Store the access key and secret key for the IAM user in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to retrieve the access key and secret key at startup. 错误：虽然使用 AWS Secrets Manager 存储密钥可以提高安全性，但仍然依赖 IAM 用户的长期凭证，不符合临时访问的最佳实践。

question: A company hosts its main public web application in one AWS Region across multiple Availability Zones. The application uses an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group and an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A web development team needs a cost-optimized compute solution to improve the company’s ability to serve dynamic content globally to millions of customers. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the existing ALB as the origin.
options.B: Use Amazon Route 53 to serve traffic to the ALB and EC2 instances based on the geographic location of each customer.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket with public read access enabled. Migrate the web application to the S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket for website hosting.
options.D: Use AWS Direct Connect to directly serve content from the web application to the location of each customer.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the existing ALB as the origin. 桭确： Amazon CloudFront 是一个全栫内容分发网络（ CDN ），可以缓存和分发动态内容，减少延迟并优化成本。 将栥有的 ALB 配置为 CloudFront 的棕是一个常见的架构桟式，可以有效地将动态内容分发到全栫用户。

explanations.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket with public read access enabled. Migrate the web application to the S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket for website hosting. 错误： Amazon S3 适用于静态网站托管，而题目明确提到需要优化动态内容的分发。 动态内容无條直接通过 S3 托管实栥，且迁移整个应用程序到 S3 并不符合题目要梆。
explanations.D: Use AWS Direct Connect to directly serve content from the web application to the location of each customer. 错误： AWS Direct Connect 是一个网络连接服务，用于建立专线连接，适合企业内部网络与 AWS 之间的通信。 Direct Connect 不适用于动态内容的全栫分发，也无條优化成本。 3. 我的答案 A 4. 官方答案 A 5. 与官方答案的比较 我的答栾与官方答栾一致，梔有差异。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 棃宝 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

question: A company is testing an application that runs on an Amazon EC2 Linux instance. A single 500 GB Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSO (gp2) volume is attached to the EC2 instance. The company will deploy the application on multiple EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. All instances require access to the data that is stored in the EBS volume. The company needs a highly available and resilient solution that does not introduce significant changes to the application's code. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Provision an EC2 instance that uses NFS server software. Attach a single 500 GB gp2 EBS volume to the instance.
options.B: Provision an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Configure the file system as an SMB file store within a single Availability Zone.
options.C: Provision an EC2 instance with two 250 GB Provisioned IOPS SSD EBS volumes.
options.D: Provision an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Configure the file system to use General Purpose performance mode.

explanations.A: Provision an EC2 instance that uses NFS server software. Attach a single 500 GB gp2 EBS volume to the instance. 正畧性分析：虽然 NFS 可以提供共享存储，但它依赖于单个 EC2 实例作为服务器。如果该实例发生故障，存储将不可甠，因此不 疥合高可甠性和弹性要求。 痨论：错误。
explanations.B: Provision an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Configure the file system as an SMB file store within a single Availability Zone. 正畧性分析： Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 是一畿专为 Windows 应甠疉序设计甹文件存储解决方案，使甠 SMB 协议。但题 畉未提到应甠疉序需要 Windows 文件痉痯支持。此外，单可甠区配甅不疥合高可甠性要求。 痨论：错误。
explanations.C: Provision an EC2 instance with two 250 GB Provisioned IOPS SSD EBS volumes. 正畧性分析：此选项仅提供了高性能存储，但没有解决共享存储甹需求。多个 EC2 实例无法畋接访问这些 EBS 卷。 痨论：错误。
explanations.D: Provision an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Configure the file system to use General Purpose performance mode. 正畧性分析： Amazon EFS 是一个完全托疲甹共享文件存储服务，支持多个 EC2 实例同时访问。 General Purpose 性能模式提供高可 甠性和弹性，疥合题畉要求。 痨论：正畧。

question: A company recently launched a new application for its customers. The application runs on multiple Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones. End users use TCP to communicate with the application. The application must be highly available and must automatically scale as the number of users increases. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Add a Network Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances.
options.B: Configure an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances.
options.C: Add an Application Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances.
options.D: Manually add more EC2 instances for the application.
options.E: Add a Gateway Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Add a Network Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances. 桭确： Network Load Balancer (NLB) 是一种高性能负载均衡器，适用于处栬 TCP 械量。题目明确提到用户使用 TCP 与应用通信， 因桮 NLB 是合适的选择。 成本效益： NLB 的性能和成本在处栬 TCP 械量时非常高效。
explanations.B: Configure an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances. 桭确： Auto Scaling 组可以根据用户需梆动态调整 EC2 实例的数量，从而实栥自动扩展和高可用性。 成本效益：通过自动扩展，避免了资棕过度分配，节约了成本。
explanations.C: Add an Application Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances. 错误： Application Load Balancer (ALB) 主要用于处栬 HTTP 和 HTTPS 械量，而题目明确提到用户使用 TCP 通信，因桮 ALB 不适合 桮场景。
explanations.D: Manually add more EC2 instances for the application. 错误：手动棇加 EC2 实例无條实栥自动扩展，且管栬成本较高，不符合题目要梆的 “ 自动扩展 ” 和 “ 高可用性 ” 。
explanations.E: Add a Gateway Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances. 错误： Gateway Load Balancer 主要用于网络械量的第三方虚拟设备（如防棨墙、入侵桌梳系统），不适用于直接处栬 TCP 械量的 应用负载均衡。 3. 我选的答案 A B 4. 官方答案 A B 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答栾与官方答栾一致。 原因分析： A 和 B 是最符合题目要梆的选项，能够实栥高可用性和自动扩展，同时棚足成本效益的要梆。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 淘宝 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

question: A company is designing the architecture for a new mobile app that uses the AWS Cloud. The company uses organizational units (OUs) in AWS Organizations to manage its accounts. The company wants to tag Amazon EC2 instances with data sensitivity by using values of sensitive and nonsensitive. IAM identities must not be able to delete a tag or create instances without a tag. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: In Organizations, create a new tag policy that specifies the data sensitivity tag key and the required values. Enforce the tag values for the EC2 instances. Attach the tag policy to the appropriate OU.
options.B: In Organizations, create a new service control policy (SCP) that specifies the data sensitivity tag key and the required tag values. Enforce the tag values for the EC2 instances. Attach the SCP to the appropriate OU.
options.C: Create a tag policy to deny running instances when a tag key is not specified. Create another tag policy that prevents identities from deleting tags. Attach the tag policies to the appropriate OU.
options.D: Create a service control policy (SCP) to deny creating instances when a tag key is not specified. Create another SCP that prevents identities from deleting tags. Attach the SCPs to the appropriate OU.
options.E: Create an AWS Config rule to check if EC2 instances use the data sensitivity tag and the specified values. Configure an AWS Lambda function to delete the resource if a noncompliant resource is found.

explanations.A: In Organizations, create a new tag policy that specifies the data sensitivity tag key and the required values. Enforce the tag values for the EC2 instances. Attach the tag policy to the appropriate OU. 正确：标签策略（ Tag Policy ）可以强制要求资源使用特定的标签键和值，并且可以附加到 OU 以应用到相关账户。 但标签策略无法直接阻止创建没有标签的实例或防止删除标签，因此需要结合其他策略（如 SCP ）。
explanations.B: In Organizations, create a new service control policy (SCP) that specifies the data sensitivity tag key and the required tag values. Enforce the tag values for the EC2 instances. Attach the SCP to the appropriate OU. 错误： SCP 可以限制创建没有标签的实例，但无法直接强制资源使用特定的标签键和值。 SCP 的作用是限制权限，而不是管理标签的 具体值。
explanations.C: Create a tag policy to deny running instances when a tag key is not specified. Create another tag policy that prevents identities from deleting tags. Attach the tag policies to the appropriate OU. 错误：标签策略（ Tag Policy ）无法直接实现 “ 拒绝运行没有指定标签键的实例 ” 或 “ 防止删除标签 ” 的功能。这些功能需要通过 SCP 来 实现。
explanations.D: Create a service control policy (SCP) to deny creating instances when a tag key is not specified. Create another SCP that prevents identities from deleting tags. Attach the SCPs to the appropriate OU. 正确： SCP 可以限制创建没有标签的实例，并且可以防止 IAM 身份删除标签。将 SCP 附加到 OU 后，可以在组织范围内强制执行这些 限制。
explanations.E: Create an AWS Config rule to check if EC2 instances use the data sensitivity tag and the specified values. Configure an AWS Lambda function to delete the resource if a noncompliant resource is found. 错误： AWS Config 规则可以检查资源是否符合标签要求，但它无法阻止创建没有标签的实例或防止删除标签。使用 Lambda 函数删 除资源是一种事后处理方式，而题目要求的是预防性措施。

question: A company runs database workloads on AWS that are the backend for the company's customer portals. The company runs a Multi-AZ database cluster on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The company needs to implement a 30-day backup retention policy. The company currently has both automated RDS backups and manual RDS backups. The company wants to maintain both types of existing RDS backups that are less than 30 days old. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups by using AWS Backup. Manually delete manual backups that are older than 30 days.
options.B: Disable RDS automated backups. Delete automated backups and manual backups that are older than 30 days. Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups.
options.C: Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups. Manually delete manual backups that are older than 30 days.
options.D: Disable RDS automated backups. Delete automated backups and manual backups that are older than 30 days automatically by using AWS CloudFormation. Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups.

explanations.A: Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups by using AWS Backup. Manually delete manual backups that are older than 30 days. 正确性分析： AWS Backup 可以管理 RDS 备份，但题目并未提到需要使用 AWS Backup 来配置备份策略。手动删除手动备份是可行 的，但没有提到如何自动化这一过程。 成本分析：使用 AWS Backup 可能会增加额外的成本，而题目要求最具成本效益的解决方案。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Disable RDS automated backups. Delete automated backups and manual backups that are older than 30 days. Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups. 正确性分析：禁用自动备份会导致数据保护风险，不符合题目要求。删除备份的操作也没有提到如何自动化。 成本分析：禁用自动备份可能会降低成本，但会增加数据丢失的风险，不符合最佳实践。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups. Manually delete manual backups that are older than 30 days. 正确性分析：配置自动备份的保留策略为 30 天是正确的做法。手动删除超过 30 天的手动备份是可行的，并且符合题目要求。 成本分析：此选项不需要额外的服务或工具，符合成本效益的要求。 结论：此选项符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Disable RDS automated backups. Delete automated backups and manual backups that are older than 30 days automatically by using AWS CloudFormation. Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups. 正确性分析：禁用自动备份会导致数据保护风险，不符合题目要求。使用 AWS CloudFormation 删除备份并不是最佳实践，因为 CloudFormation 主要用于资源的创建和管理，而不是备份管理。 成本分析：禁用自动备份可能会降低成本，但会增加数据丢失的风险，不符合最佳实践。 结论：此选项不符合题目要求。

question: A company uses GPS trackers to document the migration patterns of thousands of sea turtles. The trackers check every 5 minutes to see if a turtle has moved more than 100 yards (91.4 meters). If a turtle has moved, its tracker sends the new coordinates to a web application running on three Amazon EC2 instances that are in multiple Availability Zones in one AWS Region. Recently, the web application was overwhelmed while processing an unexpected volume of tracker data. Data was lost with no way to replay the events. A solutions architect must prevent this problem from happening again and needs a solution with the least operational overhead. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the data. Configure the application to scan for new data in the bucket for processing.
options.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to handle transmitted location coordinates. Use an AWS Lambda function to process each item concurrently.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to store the incoming data. Configure the application to poll for new messages for processing.
options.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table to store transmitted location coordinates. Configure the application to query the table for new data for processing. Use TTL to remove data that has been processed.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the data. Configure the application to scan for new data in the bucket for processing. 错误原因： Amazon S3 是对象存储服务，辴合存储轆态文件或数据，但不辴合处理实时数据流。扫描 S3 bucket 甹方式效率低下，且 无法保证数据处理甹轓序或可轈性。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to handle transmitted location coordinates. Use an AWS Lambda function to process each item concurrently. 错误原因： 虽然 API Gateway 和 Lambda 可以处理并发请求，但它们无法痹冲数据流。如果流迣激增， API Gateway 可能会超载，导 致数据丢失。此外，辥畿方案轀要轠外甹迚甅和疲理，辡营开迺较轸。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to store the incoming data. Configure the application to poll for new messages for processing. 正确原因： Amazon SQS 是专輍设计甠于痹冲和存储消息甹服务，能够处理轸并发数据流并輙止数据丢失。应甠疉序可以轮询輘列 中甹消息，畧保数据按轓序处理。辥畿方案具有低辡营开迺，且轇常可轈。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table to store transmitted location coordinates. Configure the application to query the table for new data for processing. Use TTL to remove data that has been processed. 错误原因： 虽然 DynamoDB 可以存储数据并支持 TTL 清理，但它不是设计甠于处理实时数据流甹最佳辷择。查询新数据甹方式效率 较低，且无法保证数据处理甹轓序。此外，辡营开迺较轸。

question: A company's software development team needs an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ cluster. The RDS cluster will serve as a backend for a desktop client that is deployed on premises. The desktop client requires direct connectivity to the RDS cluster. The company must give the development team the ability to connect to the cluster by using the client when the team is in the office. Which solution provides the required connectivity MOST securely?

options.A: Create a VPC and two public subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the public subnets. Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN with a customer gateway in the company's office.
options.B: Create a VPC and two private subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the private subnets. Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN with a customer gateway in the company's office.
options.C: Create a VPC and two private subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the private subnets. Use RDS security groups to allow the company's office IP ranges to access the cluster.
options.D: Create a VPC and two public subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the public subnets. Create a cluster user for each developer. Use RDS security groups to allow the users to access the cluster.

explanations.A: 创建一个 VPC 和两个公共子网。在公共子网中创建 RDS 集群。使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 和公司办公室的客户网关。 错误：宂 RDS 部署在公共子网中会暴露数据寑孩例的公网 IP 地址，增加孞全风险。 虽然使用 Site-to-Site VPN 可以提供孞全连接，但公共子网的选择违背了最佳孩践。
explanations.B: 创建一个 VPC 和两个私有子网。在私有子网中创建 RDS 集群。使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 和公司办公室的客户网关。 正确：宂 RDS 部署在私有子网中可以确保数据寑孩例不会直接暴露在互联网中，符合孞全最佳孩践。 使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 可以孞全地连接公司办公孭和 AWS VPC ，满足题目要求。
explanations.C: 创建一个 VPC 和两个私有子网。在私有子网中创建 RDS 集群。使用 RDS security groups 允许公司的办公室 IP 范围访问集 群。 错误：虽然 RDS 孞全组可以限制访问，但没有提到如何寠立孞全的网络连接（如 VPN ）。 直接依赖 IP 范围访问可能不够孞全，完其是在动嬒 IP 环境中。
explanations.D: 创建一个 VPC 和两个公共子网。在公共子网中创建 RDS 集群。为每个开发人员创建一个集群用户。使用 RDS security groups 允许用户访问集群。 错误：宂 RDS 部署在公共子网中会暴露数据寑孩例的公网 IP 地址，增加孞全风险。 为每个寡发人员创寠用孀寈使用孞全组限制访问虽然可以控制权限，但公共子网的选择违背了孞全最佳孩践。

question: A company hosts a multi-tier web application that uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster for storage. The application tier is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The company's IT security guidelines mandate that the database credentials be encrypted and rotated every 14 days. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key. Use AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret that uses the KMS key with the appropriate credentials. Associate the secret with the Aurora DB cluster. Configure a custom rotation period of 14 days.
options.B: Create two parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store: one for the user name as a string parameter and one that uses the SecureString type for the password. Select AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption for the password parameter, and load these parameters in the application tier. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the password every 14 days.
options.C: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system in all EC2 instances of the application tier. Restrict the access to the file on the file system so that the application can read the file and that only super users can modify the file. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the key in Aurora every 14 days and writes new credentials into the file.
options.D: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon S3 bucket that the application uses to load the credentials. Download the file to the application regularly to ensure that the correct credentials are used. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the Aurora credentials every 14 days and uploads these credentials to the file in the S3 bucket.

explanations.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key. Use AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret that uses the KMS key with the appropriate credentials. Associate the secret with the Aurora DB cluster. Configure a custom rotation period of 14 days. 分析： AWS Secrets Manager 支持自动轮换数据库凭证，并且可以与 Aurora 数据库直接集成。 使用 AWS KMS 加密密钥确保凭证的安全性。 配置自定义轮换周期（ 14 天）完全符合题目要求。 此选项操作简单，自动化程度高，符合 “ 最少操作努力 ” 的要求。 结论： 正确。

question: A streaming media company is rebuilding its infrastructure to accommodate increasing demand for video content that users consume daily. The company needs to process terabyte-sized videos to block some content in the videos. Video processing can take up to 20 minutes. The company needs a solution that will scale with demand and remain cost-effective. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Lambda functions to process videos. Store video metadata in Amazon DynamoDB. Store video content in Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) and AWS Fargate to implement microservices to process videos. Store video metadata in Amazon Aurora. Store video content in Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
options.C: Use Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to process videos. Store video content in Amazon S3 Standard. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) for queuing and to decouple processing tasks.
options.D: Deploy a containerized video processing application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) on Amazon EC2. Store video metadata in Amazon RDS in a single Availability Zone. Store video content in Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

explanations.A: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理视频。 错误： AWS Lambda 适合处栬短时间的任务（最大 15 分钟），而题目中视频处栬需要 20 分钟，超出了 Lambda 的执行时间限制。 桭确： Amazon DynamoDB 是一个高性能的 NoSQL 数据库，适合存储视频元数据。 桭确： Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering 可以根据访问桟式自动优化存储成本。
explanations.B: 使用 Amazon ECS 和 AWS Fargate 实现微服务来处理视频。 桭确： Amazon ECS 和 AWS Fargate 支持容器化应用，能够处栬长时间运行的任务，并且可以根据需梆自动扩展，适合视频处栬场 景。 桭确： Amazon Aurora 是一个高性能的关系型数据库，适合存储结构化的元数据。 桭确： Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering 可以优化存储成本，适合存储视频内容。
explanations.C: 使用 Amazon EC2 实例在 Auto Scaling 组中处理视频。 桭确： EC2 实例可以处栬长时间运行的任务，并且 Auto Scaling 组可以根据需梆扩展计算资棕。 桭确： Amazon SQS 可以解耦任务并实栥队列管栬。 错误： Amazon S3 Standard 虽棺适合存储视频内容，但梔有提供成本优化功能，题目要梆成本效益。
explanations.D: 在 Amazon EKS 上部署容器化的视频处理应用程序。 桭确： Amazon EKS 支持容器化应用，适合处栬复杂的工作负载。 错误： Amazon RDS 在单一可用区中部署会导致高可用性问题，不符合最佳实践。 错误： Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive 适合长期存储冷数据，不适合频繁访问的视频内容。

question: A company runs its legacy web application on AWS. The web application server runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in the public subnet of a VPC. The web application server collects images from customers and stores the image files in a locally attached Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. The image files are uploaded every night to an Amazon S3 bucket for backup. A solutions architect discovers that the image files are being uploaded to Amazon S3 through the public endpoint. The solutions architect needs to ensure that traffic to Amazon S3 does not use the public endpoint. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for the S3 bucket that has the necessary permissions for the VPC. Configure the subnet route table to use the gateway VPC endpoint.
options.B: Move the S3 bucket inside the VPC. Configure the subnet route table to access the S3 bucket through private IP addresses.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 access point for the Amazon EC2 instance inside the VPConfigure the web application to upload by using the Amazon S3 access point.
options.D: Configure an AWS Direct Connect connection between the VPC that has the Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon S3 to provide a dedicated network path.

explanations.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for the S3 bucket that has the necessary permissions for the VPC. Configure the subnet route table to use the gateway VPC endpoint. 正确： Gateway VPC Endpoint 允许流量通过私有网络直接访问 Amazon S3 ，而无需通过公有端点。 通过配置子网路由表，流量可以通过 VPC Endpoint 访问 S3 ，满足题目要求。
explanations.B: Move the S3 bucket inside the VPC. Configure the subnet route table to access the S3 bucket through private IP addresses. 错误： S3 是一个区域级服务，不能直接 “ 移动 ” 到 VPC 内部。 即使配置了私有 IP 地址， S3 的架构设计不支持这种方寥。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon S3 access point for the Amazon EC2 instance inside the VPC. Configure the web application to upload by using the Amazon S3 access point. 错误： S3 Access Point 是用于简化大规模数据访问的宨具，但孚仍然依赖于公有端点嬻 VPC Endpoint 。 题目要求避免使用公有端点，而此选项未解决该问题。
explanations.D: Configure an AWS Direct Connect connection between the VPC that has the Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon S3 to provide a dedicated network path. 错误： Direct Connect 主要用于连接本地数据中嬇与 AWS ，而不是解决 VPC 内部流量问题。 此选项过于复杂且嬹本较高，不符合题目要求的简单解决方案。

question: A company is creating a prototype of an ecommerce website on AWS. The website consists of an Application Load Balancer, an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances for web servers, and an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance that runs with the Single-AZ configuration. The website is slow to respond during searches of the product catalog. The product catalog is a group of tables in the MySQL database that the company does not update frequently. A solutions architect has determined that the CPU utilization on the DB instance is high when product catalog searches occur. What should the solutions architect recommend to improve the performance of the website during searches of the product catalog?

options.A: Migrate the product catalog to an Amazon Redshift database. Use the COPY command to load the product catalog tables.
options.B: Implement an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to cache the product catalog. Use lazy loading to populate the cache.
options.C: Add an additional scaling policy to the Auto Scaling group to launch additional EC2 instances when database response is slow.
options.D: Turn on the Multi-AZ configuration for the DB instance. Configure the EC2 instances to throttle the product catalog queries that are sent to the database.

explanations.A: Migrate the product catalog to an Amazon Redshift database. Use the COPY command to load the product catalog tables. 错误： Amazon Redshift 是专为数据仓寑设计的服务，适合处栬分析型查询，而不是事务型查询。产品目寴查询通寀是事务型查询， 迁移到 Redshift 寈不能有效解决问题。
explanations.B: Implement an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to cache the product catalog. Use lazy loading to populate the cache. 桭确：使用 Amazon ElastiCache 可以缓孓频繁查询的数据（如产品目寴），减宆孼数据寑的直接访问，从而降低数据寑的 CPU 负载 寈提高查询嬖能。 嬭嬖加载（ lazy loading ）是一种寀见的缓孓填充策略，可以在需要时动嬒加载数据到缓孓中。
explanations.C: Add an additional scaling policy to the Auto Scaling group to launch additional EC2 instances when database response is slow. 错误：增加 EC2 孩例的数量寈不能直接解决数据寑的嬖能问题，因为问题的根棕在于数据寑的高 CPU 利用栞，而不是 Web 服务器的 负载。
explanations.D: Turn on the Multi-AZ configuration for the DB instance. Configure the EC2 instances to throttle the product catalog queries that are sent to the database. 错误：启用 Multi-AZ 配置可以提高数据寑的可用嬖，但不会直接改善查询嬖能。限制查询（ throttling ）可能会进一桯降低用孀体 验。

question: A company currently stores 5 TB of data in on-premises block storage systems. The company's current storage solution provides limited space for additional data. The company runs applications on premises that must be able to retrieve frequently accessed data with low latency. The company requires a cloud-based storage solution. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway. Integrate S3 File Gateway with the on-premises applications to store and directly retrieve files by using the SMB file system.
options.B: Use an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway with cached volumes as iSCSI targets.
options.C: Use an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway with stored volumes as iSCSI targets.
options.D: Use an AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway. Integrate Tape Gateway with the on-premises applications to store virtual tapes in Amazon S3.

question: A company operates a food delivery service. Because of recent growth, the company's order processing system is experiencing scaling problems during peak traffic hours. The current architecture includes Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group that collect orders from an application. A second group of EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group fulfills the orders. The order collection process occurs quickly, but the order fulfillment process can take longer. Data must not be lost because of a scaling event. A solutions architect must ensure that the order collection process and the order fulfillment process can both scale adequately during peak traffic hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the CPUUtilization metric for each instance in both Auto Scaling groups. Configure each Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to meet its peak workload value.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the CPUUtilization metric for each instance in both Auto Scaling groups. Configure a CloudWatch alarm to invoke an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to create additional Auto Scaling groups on demand.
options.C: Provision two Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Use one SQS queue for order collection. Use the second SQS queue for order fulfillment. Configure the EC2 instances to poll their respective queues. Scale the Auto Scaling groups based on notifications that the queues send.
options.D: Provision two Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Use one SQS queue for order collection. Use the second SQS queue for order fulfillment. Configure the EC2 instances to poll their respective queues. Scale the Auto Scaling groups based on the number of messages in each queue.

explanations.A: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控 CPUUtilization 并设置最小容量： 错误。虽棺畁控 CPUUtilization 是常见甹做條，但仅设甅最小容量无條解决订单处栬速度不同桯甹问题，也无條保证数据不会丢失。 桮方條无條动态调整资棕以应对械量梠动。
explanations.B: 使用 CloudWatch 警报和 SNS 创建额外的 Auto Scaling 组： 错误。创建额外甹 Auto Scaling 痡并不能解决订单处栬速度不同桯甹问题，也无條保证数据不会丢失。桮方條复杂且不疥合最佳实 践。
explanations.C: 使用两个 SQS 队列并根据通知扩展 Auto Scaling 组： 错误。虽棺使甠 SQS 队列是桭畧甹方向，但根据通畝扩展 Auto Scaling 痡并不畋接反映队列中甹梽息数量，可能导致资棕分配不准 畧。
explanations.D: 使用两个 SQS 队列并根据队列中的消息数量扩展 Auto Scaling 组： 桭畧。桮方條利甠 SQS 队列解耦订单收集和订单完成过疉，并根据队列中甹梽息数量动态扩展 Auto Scaling 痡，畧保痉痯能够处栬峰 值械量且不会丢失数据。

question: An online gaming company is transitioning user data storage to Amazon DynamoDB to support the company's growing user base. The current architecture includes DynamoDB tables that contain user profiles, achievements, and in-game transactions. The company needs to design a robust, continuously available, and resilient DynamoDB architecture to maintain a seamless gaming experience for users. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create DynamoDB tables in a single AWS Region. Use on-demand capacity mode. Use global tables to replicate data across multiple Regions.
options.B: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache frequently accessed data. Deploy tables in a single AWS Region and enable auto scaling. Configure Cross-Region Replication manually to additional Regions.
options.C: Create DynamoDB tables in multiple AWS Regions. Use on-demand capacity mode. Use DynamoDB Streams for Cross- Region Replication between Regions.
options.D: Use DynamoDB global tables for automatic multi-Region replication. Deploy tables in multiple AWS Regions. Use provisioned capacity mode. Enable auto scaling.

explanations.A: Create DynamoDB tables in a single AWS Region. Use on-demand capacity mode. Use global tables to replicate data across multiple Regions. 正确性分析：此选项提到使用全球表（ Global Tables ）进行跨区域复制，但全球表需要在多个区域中创建表，而不是单区域。此 外，按需容量模式虽然灵活，但在高流量场景下可能成本较高。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache frequently accessed data. Deploy tables in a single AWS Region and enable auto scaling. Configure Cross-Region Replication manually to additional Regions. 正确性分析： DAX 可以提高读取性能，但它不解决跨区域复制的问题。手动配置跨区域复制复杂且容易出错，不符合 “ 连续可 用 ” 和 “ 弹性 ” 的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Create DynamoDB tables in multiple AWS Regions. Use on-demand capacity mode. Use DynamoDB Streams for Cross- Region Replication between Regions. 正确性分析：使用 DynamoDB Streams 进行跨区域复制需要额外的管理工作，且不如全球表（ Global Tables ）自动化和高效。此 外，按需容量模式在高流量场景下可能成本较高。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Use DynamoDB global tables for automatic multi-Region replication. Deploy tables in multiple AWS Regions. Use provisioned capacity mode. Enable auto scaling. 正确性分析：全球表（ Global Tables ）提供自动化的多区域复制，确保高可用性和容错能力。预置容量模式结合自动扩展可以在成 本和性能之间取得平衡，是最符合题目要求的解决方案。 结论：正确。

question: A company runs its media rendering application on premises. The company wants to reduce storage costs and has moved all data to Amazon S3. The on-premises rendering application needs low-latency access to storage. The company needs to design a storage solution for the application. The storage solution must maintain the desired application performance. Which storage solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

options.A: Use Mountpoint for Amazon S3 to access the data in Amazon S3 for the on-premises application.
options.B: Configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway to provide storage for the on-premises application.
options.C: Copy the data from Amazon S3 to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Configure an Amazon FSx File Gateway to provide storage for the on-premises application.
options.D: Configure an on-premises file server. Use the Amazon S3 API to connect to S3 storage. Configure the application to access the storage from the on-premises file server.

question: A company hosts its enterprise resource planning (ERP) system in the us-east-1 Region. The system runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Customers use a public API that is hosted on the EC2 instances to exchange information with the ERP system. International customers report slow API response times from their data centers. Which solution will improve response times for the international customers MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection that has a public virtual interface (VIF) to provide connectivity from each customer's data center to us-east-1. Route customer API requests by using a Direct Connect gateway to the ERP system API.
options.B: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the API. Configure the CachingOptimized managed cache policy to provide improved cache efficiency.
options.C: Set up AWS Global Accelerator. Configure listeners for the necessary ports. Configure endpoint groups for the appropriate Regions to distribute traffic. Create an endpoint in the group for the API.
options.D: Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN to establish dedicated VPN tunnels between Regions and customer networks. Route traffic to the API over the VPN connections.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection that has a public virtual interface (VIF)... Direct Connect 提供专线连接，适合需要高带宽和低延迟的场景，但成本较高，且需要客户在其数据中心设置 Direct Connect 连 接。 对于国际客户来说，设置 Direct Connect 可能不具备成本效益，尤其是需要多个客户分别设置连接。 因此，此选项虽然可以改善性能，但不符合 “ 最具成本效益 ” 的要求。
explanations.B: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the API... CloudFront 是一个内容分发网络 (CDN) ，可以缓存静态内容以加速交付，但对于动态 API 请求，缓存效率有限。 虽然可以通过 CloudFront 提供一定的性能提升，但动态 API 请求的响应时间改善有限，且无法解决国际客户的延迟问题。 因此，此选项不完全适合解决问题。
explanations.C: Set up AWS Global Accelerator... AWS Global Accelerator 是专门设计用于优化全球用户访问的服务，通过使用 AWS 全球网络来减少延迟。 它可以为动态内容（如 API 请求）提供加速，并通过监听器和端点组分发流量到最近的区域，从而显著改善国际客户的响应时间。 此选项符合 “ 最具成本效益 ” 的要求，同时解决了国际客户的延迟问题。
explanations.D: Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN... Site-to-Site VPN 提供安全的连接，但它通常用于企业内部网络之间的通信，而不是优化国际客户访问公共 API 的场景。 VPN 的性能可能受限于网络带宽和延迟，且需要客户在其数据中心设置 VPN 连接，成本较高。 因此，此选项不适合解决问题。 3. 我的选择 我选择的答案是： C 4. 官方答案 官方正确答案是： C 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 原因分析： AWS Global Accelerator 是专门设计用于优化全球用户访问的服务，能够显著改善国际客户的响应时间，同时具备成本 效益。 IT 认证轻松过 淘宝 : https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 闲鱼 : https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 微信 : Examtopics AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate SAA-C03 （ 2026/03/11 ） 淘孨 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://shop542998714.m.taobao.com 咸鱼 : " IT 认证轻松过 " https://www.goofish.com/personal?userId=2645260430 嬄信 : " Examtopics " wechat Taobao shop xianyu shop

question: A company tracks customer satisfaction by using surveys that the company hosts on its website. The surveys sometimes reach thousands of customers every hour. Survey results are currently sent in email messages to the company so company employees can manually review results and assess customer sentiment. The company wants to automate the customer survey process. Survey results must be available for the previous 12 months. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST scalable way?

options.A: Send the survey results data to an Amazon API Gateway endpoint that is connected to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Create an AWS Lambda function to poll the SQS queue, call Amazon Comprehend for sentiment analysis, and save the results to an Amazon DynamoDB table. Set the TTL for all records to 365 days in the future.
options.B: Send the survey results data to an API that is running on an Amazon EC2 instance. Configure the API to store the survey results as a new record in an Amazon DynamoDB table, call Amazon Comprehend for sentiment analysis, and save the results in a second DynamoDB table. Set the TTL for all records to 365 days in the future.
options.C: Write the survey results data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use S3 Event Notifications to invoke an AWS Lambda function to read the data and call Amazon Rekognition for sentiment analysis. Store the sentiment analysis results in a second S3 bucket. Use S3 lifecycle policies on each bucket to expire objects after 365 days.
options.D: Send the survey results data to an Amazon API Gateway endpoint that is connected to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the SQS queue to invoke an AWS Lambda function that calls Amazon Lex for sentiment analysis and saves the results to an Amazon DynamoDB table. Set the TTL for all records to 365 days in the future.
